subject: This is our mission
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Integrity First Voter Action Project, www
body:
Our mission boils down to one thing: Increasing voter participation across the country.
A participation rate for eligible voters that hovers below 70% in most elections is abysmally low. That means millions of our fellow Americans feel disengaged, or feel their vote is meaningless, or are being outright suppressed by the policies where they live. We're working to change that, one voter at a time.
Please, Team, RUSH $25 or more right now to fuel our efforts to educate Americans about their rights, get them registered, and turn them out to vote in the next election >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=090425_2&amount=25]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
folks,
We're gearing up to engage voters across the country ahead of elections this year. That means meeting voters where they are , from young voters to voters of color to disabled voters who need mail-in ballots to cast a ballot.
With essential elections up and down the ballot in 2025 and next year’s midterm elections fast approaching, our work to mobilize these voters is more important than ever. That’s why we’re making it a priority to help potential new voters make a lifelong habit of voting, return lapsed voters to the process, and make sure long-term voters can still participate.
This work doesn't happen overnight , and getting people in every corner of the nation excited to vote requires a lot of resources. We started months ahead of these elections to make a worthwhile investment to reach voters wherever they are — online, on college campuses, and more.
Our mission is simple: The more people who vote, the more our government looks like what we, the people, want it to be. But to reach these voters and get them involved, we need your help .
Will you chip in $25 or whatever you can today to help us reach every voter we can ahead of their next election? >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-infrastructure?refcode=090425_2&amount=25]

name: Ron Wyden
subject: This is about protecting Oregonians
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Wyden for Senate
body:
Trump’s administration prioritizes brute force over civil rights.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/114629910/567645628/2140832878?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDEvMS84OTQxMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2MDBkMGNmNy1lYjg5LWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=Eu177qwZD_kL5RRpdEhHqnuR6Wr0aHgwzwYUxrYsUW4=&emci=91266751-e289-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=600d0cf7-eb89-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=9818364)
---

| | Communities are living in fear right now as masked and unidentified ICE agents snatch people off the streets with no due process. That's not hyperbole; **it has been the policy of the Trump Administration from Day 1 of this term to prioritize brute force over civil rights, and to have law enforcement appear more threatening by making them anonymous.** And over the past few weeks, members of the Trump administration – including his own son Donald Trump Jr. – have made comments about targeting cities like Portland next with their federal occupations. Recently, when Trump's "border czar" Tom Homan made plans to visit Oregon, I urged him to join me for one of my open town halls to explain his policies and hear directly from the people his ICE agents are affecting. Instead, he silently skulked in and out of Portland to quietly meet with ICE agents without facing Oregonians. It's clear that the Trump administration has Portland in its sights. **So I've introduced a bill to restore a key area of accountability: requiring ICE agents to**** _always_****have clear identification and banning them from wearing masks when making arrests.** It's one of the core tenets of our justice system that those enforcing the law must identify themselves. If they don't, trust, public safety, and social order cannot be sustained. **Keeping Oregonians and our communities safe**** _and_****maintaining due process are not mutually exclusive, no matter what Donald Trump and his henchmen say.** Oregonians deserve the peace of mind to know they can walk home without masked agents sweeping them up at a moment's notice and not being read their rights. They deserve an end to the terror the Trump administration is _deliberately_ instilling. It's time we made ICE agents **visible** and **accountable** , and I won't stop fighting to get it done. More soon, _Ron_ |
---|---|---

| | Paid for and authorized by Wyden for Senate.
---

name: The Democrats
subject: An explanation:
body:
---
Derek, Today, we are going to ask you to make your next donation directly to the DNC — but first, we hope you’ll give us a chance to explain why we need your support right now. Here’s the deal:
* Trump has threatened to end mail-in voting and asked Republicans to redraw congressional maps across the country in their favor.
* He has mobilized the National Guard to occupy Washington, D.C. — and has threatened to do the same to other cities.
* Trump has even threatened to pull the television licenses of news agencies that have accurately covered his disastrous second term in office.

Trump wants people to be afraid of opposing him. He wants to intimidate us into silence. He and his allies are counting on Democrats completely giving up. We can’t let that happen. That’s why this month is so important. September has just begun, but in just a few weeks, we face our most important end-of-quarter fundraising deadline since the 2024 election. At the end of September, we will be required to report how much we’ve raised over the last few months. Those numbers will tell a story: A lot of contributions will show the strength of Democrats’ opposition to Trump and his agenda. _They’ll show we aren’t done fighting._ **[So, Derek, we’re asking: Can you chip in $10 to the DNC today to show Republicans that Trump’s threats won’t stop you — or thousands of other grassroots supporters just like you — from fighting back?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-dnc-september-2025?refcode=em_20250904_4497_fr&amount=10&refcode2=4497_22930333_sYxVxf&akid=4497%2E22930333%2EsYxVxf)**

name: Wes Moore
subject: Deploying the National Guard is very serious
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Lofgren for Congress
body:
Donald Trump’s decision to deploy the National Guard in D.C. is deeply dangerous, Peter.
As someone who has served this country overseas and who is commander-in-chief of the Maryland National Guard, I take this very seriously.
Donald Trump’s policies have raised unemployment, made people lose their healthcare, and cut food benefits for children. Now he’s using citizen-soldiers as a distraction and as a cudgel to advance his own political purposes.
If he really wanted to address the issue of crime, he could look at what we’re doing in Maryland.
We’ve helped to lead the country in drops in violent crime, shootings, and carjackings. Our number one priority is making sure people feel safe in their communities — and our policies, from investing in law enforcement to investing in community violence prevention, reflect that priority.
Instead, Donald Trump and his administration are not treating our government resources and the people who choose to serve in our National Guard with the seriousness they deserve.
I’m embarrassed, I’m angered, and I’m heartbroken by these political games. Our servicemembers should not be used as a tool for advancing anyone’s agenda — and as Maryland’s Governor, I will not use our servicemembers for a political ploy.
If you agree with me, I hope you can split a contribution of any amount between my campaign and Zoe Lofgren so we can continue moving forward. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/partner-ms-wes-em-zoe-lofgren-split-q32025?amount=25&refcode=EM_ALL_ZOL_FRS_1_2025-09-04_WMR_DJT_ES-30526]
Thank you, Peter.

Wes

I’m embarrassed, I’m angered, and I’m heartbroken by these political games. Our servicemembers should not be used as a tool for advancing anyone’s agenda — and as Maryland’s Governor, I will not use our servicemembers for a political ploy. So it pains me to see everyday folks working harder than ever but still falling behind – while D.C. politicians give handout after handout to their wealthy donors and corporate special interest friends.

This isn’t about left versus right. It’s about who you fight for – and who you’re willing to stand up to.
When we fought to save the pensions of tens-of-thousands of Ohio retirees, we stood up to Wall Street and won. When we fought to cap insulin prices and bring down the cost of prescription drugs, we stood up to Big Pharma and _won._

Now, our opponents see her momentum and they’re coming after us. We have to act now to protect Katie’s lead. Getting our own ads up will be expensive, but it could make all the difference in a state as large as California. That’s why we need you, Peter. Thank you, Katie Porter HQ Katie is running to be California’s next governor because California and our country need a leader who will stand up to Trump to lower costs, protect our rights, and combat climate change.

Since launching this campaign, I have visited communities all across the Commonwealth — from Farmville to Fairfax, Richmond to Roanoke — to hear directly from Virginians about the challenges they face.
_And that's informed what we communicate and how we spend our resources._
My opponent, Winsome Earle-Sears, has shown she's in lockstep with Trump's agenda. She downplayed the White House laying off thousands of Virginia workers by saying, "don't fret." And she boasted that Trump's disastrous tax law does "so many great things." _We're talking about a policy that cuts $1 trillion from Medicaid and slashes resources for public schools here._
I've given voters my word: **As Governor, I will always put them first and stand up to the chaos coming out of Washington.**
We can't be defined by what we're against — we must focus on moving our Commonwealth forward.
That's why I have announced my plans to grow our workforce and raise the minimum wage, to reduce the cost of childcare, and to make life more affordable from healthcare and prescription drugs to housing costs and utility bills.
With the remaining days left in this campaign, I'm counting on a surge of grassroots donations to:
✅ Visit every corner of Virginia.
✅ Reach undecided voters with ads and counter the GOP's attacks.
✅ Build the largest organizing operation our Commonwealth's ever seen.

Folks, let's not mince words, Florida Republicans--[the dumber cousin of Florida Man](https://substack.com/redirect/93780096-ee8e-4153-8e0e-f10616b25b54?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--have declared war on science and public health. Dumpy, dingy, douchey Ron DeSantis and his Surgeon General just **eliminated vaccine requirements for schoolchildren**.
It is really hard to put into words how mind-numbingly, [Dumb-&-Dumber, aluminum-rod-through-your-parietal-lobe-level stupid](https://substack.com/redirect/9458e8a9-6eea-4770-a0b4-d8fd7dadd704?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) this is. It's the intellectual equivalent of stepping off a 5th floor roof and assuming a nice breeze will overtake gravity.
What this means is kids in Florida classrooms may now be forced to sit next to [a human disease vector](https://substack.com/redirect/31d1f524-71d2-4642-8970-cb7d00b537e2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) of peers unprotected from measles, polio, rubella--the very pandemics modern medicine defeated generations ago.
We considered ending these plagues some of our greatest achievements.
Leave it to [the MAGA Ivermectin-humpers](https://substack.com/redirect/efda7104-dcd2-4be3-9285-3821073eecb4?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to leave no stone unturned when trying to destroy America from within. Seriously, are we gonna give anyone with a high fever a good "bleeding" soon?
Side inquiry: How the fuck [can anyone with a three-digit IQ be Republican anymore](https://substack.com/redirect/cdd20965-974d-4928-9f39-93a5f105e3ae?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)? Do you just plan to bury your brain in a pile of used kitty litter and hope the sand and stink cloud the fact that **before the measles vaccine was introduced in the U.S.,**_**2.6 million Americans died from measles every year**_**.**
**Yes, that word before year was "every."**
As if this wasn't all reckless enough, [DeSantis's top doc compared vaccines to slavery](https://substack.com/redirect/cb1d1496-5b42-424b-8b4c-a45401040985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Yes, slavery. JFC, is there any way we can turn the GOP off and back on again, see if they suddenly possess firing neurons?
In any case, this is what passes for leadership in the Sunshine State--a gerrymandered hellhole of strip malls, stand your ground and climate disaster. I'm sure this will turn your dying tourism industry right around, guys!
Old folks will really wanna keep moving and snow-birding there once kids start causing regular outbreaks of the hantavirus. Well done, DeSanctimonious.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.hpjJS-N0SJgyEJ-csdSuLrlVhLz9nZbGbt8Z3UZfRFU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=172804653)
But, this honestly is personal. As David Schuster said on the show today, his kids just went through their vaccine updates before starting school in Connecticut. They cried a little at the doctor's office, but they're protected--and so are the other kids.
That's what a functioning society does. Florida's new policy isn't "freedom." It's an invitation to bring back outbreaks that once crippled entire communities.
But the madness doesn't stop there.
Across the country, [Trump's GOP continues to champion policies that literally kill people](https://substack.com/redirect/6cd45fdf-3766-403e-baa3-da77b9190325?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). They've ripped away abortion rights, leaving women to suffer sepsis in ERs. They've armed civilians with battlefield weapons that shred children so badly DNA testing is needed for identification.
And now, they're gunning to roll back vaccines. This isn't governing--it's [more ](https://substack.com/redirect/216935cb-afdf-4c12-a146-107353430018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[state-sponsored terrorism](https://substack.com/redirect/216935cb-afdf-4c12-a146-107353430018?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**.
### Maine's Fight for the Future
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/715bdedd-c340-4232-a63d-8f947ca97338?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Amid this chaos, we talked with Angus King III, who's running for governor of Maine.
King was earnest about his beliefs, not afraid to rip into Republicans and Trump, while allowing that his natural instinct is to try to work _with_ people. But he's a realist, and understands that [with today's Republican Party](https://substack.com/redirect/2bc7ad48-9c68-4bc3-bcfb-15ae3ca870c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), "sometimes we'll have to go it alone."
King isn't just surfing on his father, Senator Angus King's, name. He has long worked as a leader and champion in Maine of renewable energy, as well as providing affordable housing.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack.com/redirect/2/eyJlIjoiaHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuYmx1ZWFtcC5jby9zdWJzY3JpYmU_.hpjJS-N0SJgyEJ-csdSuLrlVhLz9nZbGbt8Z3UZfRFU?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=172804653)
So King is focused on these issues, of paramount importance to Mainers right now: skyrocketing housing costs, collapsing rural healthcare, tariffs that squeeze working families, and education that's fallen behind.
But he was also clear when I posed the question of whether he'd line up to stop Trump from illegally entering Maine--commandeering state troops and city police--that [he'd be there to tell Trump to "stay out,"](https://substack.com/redirect/cb1d1496-5b42-424b-8b4c-a45401040985?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) to his face. He'd defend democracy.
[King's message? Be authentic](https://substack.com/redirect/e931b34e-ddac-44ab-8f57-ebeb277a408e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), fight when necessary, and never lose sight of who government is supposed to serve. He even joined in a few jokes to show he could take 'em, and he could make 'em.
Especially when it came to turning "cow poop" into clean energy.
So the contrast couldn't be clearer. One side wants to drag us back to the 12th century, cheering on plague and ignorance. The other side is fighting to lower food and housing costs, strengthen healthcare, and invest in our kids' futures--[to make it affordable for Americans to live in America again](https://substack.com/redirect/2bc7ad48-9c68-4bc3-bcfb-15ae3ca870c6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg).
In a democratic republic.
This isn't just about politics--it's about survival, dignity, and whether our children inherit progress or plague.
Stay tuned. Stay loud. And don't let the rot of Ron DeSantis, [Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/e3ed808a-2247-489c-8f7f-b59454f0c386?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), or the GOP's death cult define America's future.
--Cliff

subject: On the Road: Protecting Land, Rights of Nature & Demanding Justice
body:
Stand with Crystal & Jason—protect sacred sites and Indigenous voices. Help us defend NC’s most significant archaeological site in decades. | | | Dear Friends & Relatives, Jason and I are on the road in Ohio this week, speaking at the **Land Trust Alliance Rally 2025 Conference**. This gathering brings together people working in land conservation from across the country. We are honored to share our perspective on the **Rights of Nature,** challenging the way land is often viewed—not just as property, but as a living relative with rights of its own. Being here has me thinking deeply about land in our own home state of North Carolina—especially the ongoing fight in **Carteret County**. Last summer, the Office of State Archaeology released a report confirming that**thousands****of Native American artifacts were discovered** during construction at the Bridge View housing development in Cedar Point. The state’s chief archaeologist even called the site the **most significant find he has seen in 30 years**. In response, Native people from across North Carolina gathered there to hold a ceremony and honor our ancestors. Yet today, developers still plan to build houses on this **highly significant archaeological site** , where Native American remains have been found. A special prosecutor has been requested to review the **Carteret County Native American–Bridge View case**. This fight is not only about protecting land—it’s also about safeguarding Indigenous voices. After over a year of **targeted attacks, harassment, and now legal threats** , my relatives and I have been served with **cease-and-desist and defamation claims** simply for speaking the truth about the violence that occurred at Cedar Point on June 23, 2024. These actions are clear attempts to silence Indigenous voices, erase history, and punish those of us who stand up for sacred burial grounds.
But we will not be silenced. This is bigger than one family—it is part of the ongoing targeting of Indigenous women leaders and communities who defend our Peoples and Mother Earth. Here’s how you can help right now:
* **Show Your Solidarity** – Show up September 29, in Carteret County, stand with us in calling for an end to the harassment and intimidation of Indigenous leaders.
* **[Donate to the Legal Defense Fund](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm39V2-dYSuxTJAeyIhirfEa4H2XkzeE3iI70Knihtytsc8457Xchcp-6MLHiX9GdgYy0qW9Sp1XAlZfFFfWdpjHl0lEEfS93jLIV4ftylLVyoj70jRxAEyxhPn5LWp5LOfeAFz9J08hbmY5pKEhC3EytY-5rcBO7GXvOczFBpH0n5VO80Y5q98tcTgFyK3kz7ebfEVRzHa0msR_W40439K-bo9wJagXSdyrNmFs3_wRcS0F8anrTjBNE9nsUJ2vMy7v-ez-m2LS6I2mIx1nD38gXpmINdPgUqOx9SilEkuH_ecU_i8EVw-i-2FPMSOaXFqNjnSCsn8oqizX2VhFAH0gzsXDfExFJWAgc-xHWe153C3u7-Ct6LvbSFPVipyeAJ28JPWtBLbHGCPGZ0o1W9NET/4jn/jdkSZNHYQwiazM__Rt_JJw/h0/h001.o7GJhXRP3XopRmX9CKkzMTjRwQA7V1eV7imxU7BCsQU)** – Your contribution directly supports legal expenses and community protection.
* **Contact Local Officials** – Urge them to protect the Carteret County Sacred sites and stop the legal harassment of Indigenous families.

As we speak to land conservation leaders here in Ohio, we are reminded that **protecting land and honoring those who came before us is everyone’s responsibility**. Together, we can make sure our lands, waters, and ancestors are defended with the care they deserve—and that those who speak truth will not be silenced. Thank you for your prayers, solidarity, and continued support. Your love gives us the strength to keep going. In solidarity,
Crystal & Jason

A special prosecutor has been requested to review the Carteret County Native American–Bridge View case. This fight is not only about protecting land—it’s also about safeguarding Indigenous voices. After over a year of targeted attacks, harassment, and now legal threats , my relatives and I have been served with cease-and-desist and defamation claims simply for speaking the truth about the violence that occurred at Cedar Point on June 23, 2024. These actions are clear attempts to silence Indigenous voices, erase history, and punish those of us who stand up for sacred burial grounds. But we will not be silenced. This is bigger than one family—it is part of the ongoing targeting of Indigenous women leaders and communities who defend our Peoples and Mother Earth. Here’s how you can help right now: Show Your Solidarity – Show up September 29, in Carteret County, stand with us in calling for an end to the harassment and intimidation of Indigenous leaders. – Your contribution directly supports legal expenses and community protection. Contact Local Officials – Urge them to protect the Carteret County Sacred sites and stop the legal harassment of Indigenous families. As we speak to land conservation leaders here in Ohio, we are reminded that protecting land and honoring those who came before us is everyone’s responsibility**. Together, we can make sure our lands, waters, and ancestors are defended with the care they deserve—and that those who speak truth will not be silenced. Thank you for your prayers, solidarity, and continued support. Your love gives us the strength to keep going. | Dear Fellow American,

**In today’s world, it’s hard to know who to trust...**
That’s why for the past 31 years, your **Judicial Watch** has successfully fought public corruption and unlawful government secrecy to encourage honesty in government...and on occasion, thanks to the support of members like you, _we’ve_ _even changed the course_ _of history_.
And in today’s world, we are busier than ever...working side-by-side with **President Trump** as he works to fulfill his promise of restoring Americans’ trust in government!
And what a difference we are seeing!
**President Trump** is taking action to:

* **Direct****mass****deportations** of illegal aliens, criminal aliens first

* **Terminate****“Diversity, Equity, Inclusion” (DEI)** programs that spread racist woke propaganda in our S. Armed Forces; schools; and throughout the federal government, including the Departments of Defense, State and Education

* **Remov****e****Deep****State** officials whose loyalty was to the liberal and woke agendas, not to the S. Constitution and the rule of law

* **Eliminate** waste, fraud and abuse in TRILLIONS of dollars of bloat through the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE)

I speak for many conservatives like us on the front lines here in Washington, when I say that this feels like a springtime resurrection of hope for restoring our faith in public institutions.
**At least, that’s how I see it.**_[What do you think?](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76406&L=36017&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=e50c966956c988652c61a8112de84e94b83f2c3823d9701d85f421166f811fe2)_
My team and I care very deeply about the input from Judicial Watch members and patriotic Americans just like you, so we’ve launched this _[very important public opinion and educate project.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76406&L=36017&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=e50c966956c988652c61a8112de84e94b83f2c3823d9701d85f421166f811fe2)_
The _[survey only takes a few moments](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76406&L=36017&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=e50c966956c988652c61a8112de84e94b83f2c3823d9701d85f421166f811fe2)_ and will provide us with critical insights into what you think the Trump government is doing right. Or wrong.
We know what the mainstream media and left think, and I’m guessing they don’t speak for you. This is your opportunity to break their narratives and _[set the facts straight about how commonsense Americans feel](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76406&L=36017&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYS8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=e50c966956c988652c61a8112de84e94b83f2c3823d9701d85f421166f811fe2)_ about the state of our government.
Please take a few moments to complete the **Judicial Watch Members’ Trust in Government Survey**

Thomas Fitton

subject: JW Opinion Project: What Is Your Trust In Government?
body:
That’s why for the past 31 years, your Judicial Watch has successfully fought public corruption and unlawful government secrecy to encourage honesty in government...and on occasion, thanks to the support of members like you, we’ve even changed the course of history.

| [ | |

|

| Dear Fellow American,

**In today’s world, it’s hard to know who to trust...**
That’s why for the past 31 years, your **Judicial Watch** has successfully fought public corruption and unlawful government secrecy to encourage honesty in government...and on occasion, thanks to the support of members like you, _we’ve_ _even changed the course_ _of history_.
And in today’s world, we are busier than ever...working side-by-side with **President Trump** as he works to fulfill his promise of restoring Americans’ trust in government!
And what a difference we are seeing!
**President Trump** is taking action to:

* **Direct****mass****deportations** of illegal aliens, criminal aliens first

* **Terminate****“Diversity, Equity, Inclusion” (DEI)** programs that spread racist woke propaganda in our S. Armed Forces; schools; and throughout the federal government, including the Departments of Defense, State and Education

* **Remov****e****Deep****State** officials whose loyalty was to the liberal and woke agendas, not to the S. Constitution and the rule of law

* **Eliminate** waste, fraud and abuse in TRILLIONS of dollars of bloat through the Department of Government Efficiency (DOGE)

I speak for many conservatives like us on the front lines here in Washington, when I say that this feels like a springtime resurrection of hope for restoring our faith in public institutions.
**At least, that’s how I see it.**_[What do you think?](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76408&L=36019&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=7c045278018bf69a3bd02853acf3fe28a31a6468403576f46d7b49b58dcf50bb)_
My team and I care very deeply about the input from Judicial Watch members and patriotic Americans just like you, so we’ve launched this _[very important public opinion and educate project.](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76408&L=36019&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=7c045278018bf69a3bd02853acf3fe28a31a6468403576f46d7b49b58dcf50bb)_
The _[survey only takes a few moments](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76408&L=36019&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=7c045278018bf69a3bd02853acf3fe28a31a6468403576f46d7b49b58dcf50bb)_ and will provide us with critical insights into what you think the Trump government is doing right. Or wrong.
We know what the mainstream media and left think, and I’m guessing they don’t speak for you. This is your opportunity to break their narratives and _[set the facts straight about how commonsense Americans feel](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76408&L=36019&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=7c045278018bf69a3bd02853acf3fe28a31a6468403576f46d7b49b58dcf50bb)_ about the state of our government.
Please take a few moments to complete the **Judicial Watch Members’ Trust in Government Survey**
| [YOUR OPINIONS MATTER – TAKE THE SURVEY](https://myjw.pr.judicialwatch.org/link.php?AGENCY=jw&M=27089954&N=76408&L=36019&F=H&drurl=aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cuanVkaWNpYWx3YXRjaC5vcmcvcGV0aXRpb25zL2ludDI1bmRlMDkxYi8/dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kZXBsb3llciZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPWVtYWlsJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFNamN3T0RrNU5UUSUzRCZ1dG1fY2FtcGFpZ249Tm9uLURvbm9ycyZ1dG1fdGVybT1NYXk=&hash=7c045278018bf69a3bd02853acf3fe28a31a6468403576f46d7b49b58dcf50bb)
---

**I eagerly await your survey responses.** Please get back to me as soon as you can.

Thank you for all that you do in our shared fight to restore trust and transparency in government and God bless America.

Sincerely,

Thomas Fitton
President

My name is Laura Loomer, and I'm not your typical journalist. I don't sit in a cushy newsroom parroting talking points for the elite. I'm out there, in the trenches, exposing the corruption, betrayal, and deep-state sabotage that threatens everything President Trump has fought for--and everything we believe in. Let me tell you why I do this. I've seen the lies, the cover-ups, and the cowardice firsthand. The mainstream media won't touch the stories I uncover--they're too busy protecting the Biden swamp and their globalist puppet masters. But I don't care who's in my way. I dig deeper, ask harder questions, and shine a light on the rot that's eating away at our country. And what I've found in recent weeks? **It 's enough to make your blood boil.**

**The Stories They Don 't Want You to Hear**

* **Summits of the Americas Turned Into a Woke Disaster**
Picture this: a gathering meant to strengthen America's position in the world, hijacked by Biden holdovers like Jennifer Showell and Thomas Hastings. These traitors are turning the Summits of the Americas into a pro-China, woke circus. I went down there myself, tracked their moves, and uncovered how they're undermining Trump's America First policies to cozy up to Communist China. They thought they could get away with it--but I'm making sure the world knows their names and their shame.

* **An Obama Loyalist Sabotaging Trump 's Iran Strategy**
Then there's Nathanael Swanson. This guy's an Obama-era relic, still slinking around the State Department's Iran negotiation team like a snake in the grass. Trump took a hard line against Iran--sanctions, strength, no compromise. But Swanson? He's working behind the scenes to unravel it all, putting our national security on the line. I've spent sleepless nights piecing together the paper trail of all Biden holdovers who remain inside the Trump admin, and I'm not stopping until they are all out of there for good.

* **Dan Goldman and the Democrat Cover-Up Machine**
Ever heard of Rep. Dan Goldman? He's a slick operator shielding violent Democrats like LaMonica McIver while orchestrating lawfare against Trump. I caught wind of this when I started digging into McIver's trail of chaos--Goldman's been running interference, protecting his own while the Democrats try to bury Trump under legal attacks. I've got the receipts, and I'm exposing their game one bombshell at a time.

* **Democrats Ignoring Pro-Hamas Violence**
Two Israeli diplomats were murdered in D.C. by a pro-Hamas terrorist. Two lives snuffed out, and what did Democrats like Ilhan Omar and Rashida Tlaib do? Nothing. Not a word of condemnation. They're silent because they're complicit, enabling Jew hatred and Islamic terrorism while pretending to care about justice. I've been on the ground, talking to sources, documenting every disgusting detail. They can't hide from me--and I won't let them.

* **A DEI Judge Blocking Trump 's Vision**
And then there's Judge Myong J. Joun, a Biden appointee whose family rakes in cash from DEI consulting. This guy had the nerve to block Trump's order to dismantle the Department of Education--a move that would've freed our kids from woke indoctrination. I dug into his family's financial ties, and it's clear: this isn't justice, it's a paycheck. I'm fighting to get that story out there, because our children deserve better.

**Why I Need You**

These aren't just stories--they're battles. Every day, I'm taking on the deep state, the media, and the woke mob. They hate me for it. They've tried to censor me, smear me, shut me down. But I don't flinch. I don't back off. Because this isn't about me--**it 's about you, your family, and the future of America**. It's about protecting Trump's America First agenda from the cowards and traitors trying to tear it apart.

Here's the raw truth: I don't have corporate sponsors or billionaire sugar daddies bankrolling me. I'm funded by people like you--patriots who see what's at stake and refuse to let the swamp win. [**Every dollar you donate keeps me in the fight**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2z60obi8cd5luc9kk3ck08smu6ltaet4tfs6ii0lo_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs). It pays for my plane tickets to chase leads, my late-night research, the equipment I need to break these stories. [**Without you, I 'm grounded. Without you, the truth gets buried.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zp73b8ausr1q3klrh8hqamk4ep4b1be4bn50b7ho_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs)

**Stand With Me --Right Now**

[**I 'm asking you to join me.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zolq5ve6q417aob37q8fcs95lovtt2btg5lcjklo_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs) Your donation isn't just money--it's fuel for the fire I'm lighting under these corrupt elites. It's a fist in the air against the liars and sellouts. It's a promise that we won't let them silence us. **[**Donate now**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zl42p58bu0brp7u8b3qea5836s31i4b69jpm7rao_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs)**[**and let 's hit them where it hurts--right in the open, with the truth.**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zfebq3mvrndtk7dp55vnnvc6s7o3op3rpuplphto_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs)

I'm not giving up. I've got more leads, more stories, more battles ahead. [**But I can 't do it alone**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zdrvojg73rcakjn1amrqrjai5ifsnidgem752nq0_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs). With you by my side, we can expose every single one of these rats and defend the America we love. [**Will you stand with me?**](https://e.firstlook.news/rd/9z2zn0edd86bkb1h80vlv2eecpfj22qsijtissk5flo_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hm6ob6c3h2bs)

Laura Loomer

subject: The Rare Phenomenon of Citizenship
body:
I invite you to view our eight-lecture course “American Citizenship and Its Decline,” based on Victor Davis Hanson's book, The Dying Citizen.

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2z4hvdjtlm9788rblg2ue799trtrvp08u4jq79ut8_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hmepj4cth2bs)
---
| | Dear friend, I invite you to view our eight-lecture course "**[American Citizenship and Its Decline](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zk0nphfvip4rqlbv9ptklgnuhb3t2acn53poot90_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hmepj4cth2bs)** ," based on Victor Davis Hanson's book, _The Dying Citizen_.

Like the book, the course describes the current crises in America as symptoms of a far larger problem: the steady decline of the autonomy and political influence of the citizen.

The class describes the origins and history of citizenship in the West, reminding us that it is a rare phenomenon both in the past and the present—given the enormous responsibility placed on citizens to create and control their own government.
---
| [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zi5mb15f127j0ou5jr2o7stjfh7mu54o6hm7k0k0_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hmepj4cth2bs)
---
| | Citizenship then requires a large and self-reliant middle class--currently shrinking under enormous economic strains. Clearly defined and enforced borders are also essential to ensure a civic space in which citizens can nurture common customs, sustain traditions, and honor their own shared past.

Yet borders are now increasingly fluid as mere residence and citizenship seem often indistinguishable. Pre-civilizational tribalism--identifying by superficial appearance rather than through shared culture and values--is returning to America.

These organic, bottom-up challenges are often matched by top-down stresses such as the growth of a huge, permanent, but unelected, government of bureaucrats and administrators who combine judicial, executive, and legislative powers that overwhelm the citizen.

In addition, revisionists in law, the media, and politics seek to change the Constitution, long-held customs of governance, and political traditions for short-term partisan agendas, on the theory that a new, changing, and fluid Constitution must match an always evolving human nature.

Globalism is an ancient challenge to the sovereignty of the nation-state. But in the age of instant communications and unprecedented concentrations of globalized wealth, so often elites seek to supplant American laws and independence with international organizations and often without the consent of the legislative branch or the assent of the governed.

The course ends, however, on an optimistic note that citizens still have it within their power to restore our traditions of empowered citizenship and reassert control over the government.

You can receive a DVD box set of "**American Citizenship and Its Decline** " with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more toward Hillsdale College's Annual Fund. You can easily give and reserve your DVD box set using this secure link:

[https://secured.hillsdale.edu/hillsdale/citizenship-dvd](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zs9pdvlm7mcd5v3l5ct7vbapmoepsc0raa5r0gs0_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1hmepj4cth2bs)

Best wishes,

Jeremiah Regan, Ph.D.
Executive Director of Online Learning
Hillsdale College

name: Hillsdale College via American Action News
subject: What Hemingway said
body:
You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story.

This sponsored message from American Action News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zvgidoed2d9m1i18vfpjbs6rs8gt76in30maadu0_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1jm0p72c5h2bs)
---
| | Dear Fellow American, You may be shocked to learn that thousands of public schools have recently banned a classic American story. Even if you haven’t read the book, you know the name. It’s _The Adventures of Huckleberry Finn_ by Mark Twain. **Unfortunately, political correctness has taken this literary classic out of the hands of far too many young Americans.** But here at Hillsdale College, we’re working to safeguard the legacy of this treasured classic, along with the legacy of the man regarded by many as **America’s greatest author.**
---
| | [**That is why I want to offer you a special DVD box set of our fascinating and important online course, “****Mark Twain:**_**Tom Sawyer**_**,**_**Huckleberry Finn**_**, and Selected Short Stories****.** ”](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z1boa1tbrk9hiv4kh71t7f38k008mddaumat0mq8_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1jm0p72c5h2bs) Twain’s realist fiction reveals timeless truths about human nature. And while American life has certainly changed since the 1800s, human nature has not. So these literary works are as relevant and as important as ever. Now, we have created a special DVD version of our course that includes all nine lectures. And today, [**I’d like to send you this DVD box set as our way of thanking you for supporting our educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty with a tax-deductible gift of $100 or more**](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zh0lg7tphca1l9tvrs3b211eook9d9sgj2s76c9o_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1jm0p72c5h2bs).

## Second Special Session Adjourned
State legislators [adjourned the second special session](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL2uozAQhZ_GdEbDYMOlcLENXbbdEk3sMbHk4IhxQvL2K_IKtzvF-dH5_l2WC6WctvUv3dnVdyzLxodkrpX3xZfjWj7CtGaWkvKaaKv-WWVBQKth0mCXQCl_FtMEd4UwdQ27brQjjNDh0Nwcg4EBB9uTwcH3HC0RdxFgCr6_GmySO8tgAtt1gNC3PGFkjqOdfn78QKQMcEi17G29ceU3Scyf8uK99eXeZHer9SGq_6NwVjgfx9HG8jbnjdOgcD6lwvkb1ZnXJJnqc2fRuAUtD_aJshYWSWXTvAVpdhceR8o5yTAqA-udUv7O1d9Bejn8HwAA__8zVX4x) Wednesday after passing a new congressional map and numerous other high-profile bills, including ones related to flood relief and safety, a replacement for the STAAR test, and the distribution of abortion-inducing drugs. The House and Senate [failed to reach a compromise](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL-upSAYxJ8GOwyg_CsotrG7225pPuFDSVCMcK_nvP3G8wq3mmImv8zMv6_5C1JOx_oXdnTtFct84F0ztobX7Mu9lHdFWDPWkvKa4Gj-u9VZMCEps5TJOUDK73nsgltYsLxDx7XUTDMuVLe5QSkpMSBarhQHaf0iB77YOHjtJdouuQfGLJOcM8GGHq2IiFFLa4xXAGRkGFIrV982bPiCGvO7_ODV-7J32W2tnZUMf4iYiJju--7vCPCYRExwteQzEjE9u4iYcvGQiZg-oEc3T8-rhG_fKsXXib5hoK3QC3dIB824fvLCaOqVsoOQkUYZgI4jGGolSOoNF8qMizFRd5cL551yTlVpMrJ1h5Q_Tdvv_v1x4n8AAAD__xeXjd4) on the issue of restricting the sale of consumable THC products or banning them completely. They were also unable to agree on legislation that would have [lowered the threshold](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJyk0LGO6jAQheGncTqi8YTEceHiIhTdArah2DIax5NgrcFRbCB5-xW8wvafzpH-73N_Jh_8ffqiG5u8jrG_8ysFzpmXfogvG7fENAVO0YfJ0z0Pj5x6BKx3oHdQ94582Pp94YwFp2XBRqpagQKJTXE1ykrdas1W0mCtcyOrGp0mbK2sCGThzXsMNNRSAkJVssaReVS1btuhIRJ7YOdzXMp85cwrpTFs8clLOcRbEcw15zmJ6p_ATmA30OxzDOUHllN8CuwOPoRTjD-PWWD336ccl62kNK-i6k48XTglUR1bjQKbtxXV8XKQUCzGzS8fgk-NEnuYbuTD5zT_LdXT4G8AAAD__6DLffM) for triggering local tax rate elections. Lawmakers approved bills to [enact safety measures](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkMGK4zAQRL9GvinIShxZBx3CgE87C3vao-lIraShLRm3Mh7__ZL5hb0VFBT13t_P-ROIqTx-w4Khfec6F9yFsTXc5lj3ez0E4cEolfhBUFp8NZmtsYM2XpthTkB8zJcuhbtJvu8w9G5wxpneXrtnGL3rkznniMmYnBOM8Q5jHrL3brBX11F4jxlvhr431pxP6G1GzG7w4xivAOpiMFGr26k9seE3SOajfuF2inXpODxbW0Wdb8pOyk77vp8WKe9O2QmLfomy0xtK2eknZ6416Q2ZMOsIy6oFMrZD34lZ9AoimorOVID1s7420TVrWTESsBYUoVqUnWDTt1v_68_H9NFtIa07MZNcnbqYxwLEP_fa_0n9CvZfAAAA__8Wso4j) for camps and provide $278 million for flood warning systems and disaster relief. However, they failed to approve legislation that would have [created licensing requirements](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkDHSnDAMhU9jOu8IgwEXFGno_rQpGWEEaGJsBnmX3dtn2CukUSV9eu_78zP-IAeO62_cqc_vJY2RLgmUM52jT9eUPkK4BpLEYWWM2T-zjAaM1eA02HFGDp-xLuZ-gtmVBfVla1tooTRNsfUNuoV84zqYLC3T5G0HM9m66lxVgW0L7m8YOLBlCQaqBzmzEC2tdV3nG0RVA82c0_nIG2V6oyzhk150Pnzai9BvOR-iql_KDMoM13U9fGD_12zpKTnFe0uZ4a6lzPC9V2a4fyozgLtHrcwwcQj6pm74vIXomQUl06lpp3Ol6D_6JDlSFNI7i5DohSMGjcdxphcGzVF_8VooYiZlhuLs5-PiEFiaVtWw7sjhGzv_n-xXb_4FAAD__yL7lpc) for local emergency coordinators. ## PowerSchool Sued Over Data Breach

## Ruth Paine, Tied to JFK Case, Dies at 92
Ruth Paine, a former Irving resident who [befriended Lee Harvey Oswald's wife](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLFygzAQRL9GdGZOB0ioUJGGzmlTMgc6YU1k8EiysfP1GZL8QbotdvfN7sd5PFOIYV3e6cq2PP02rrznyKVwGudtn7ZXZloi5y3EJdBa5nvJIwJ2JzAn6EZHIb7GtnJ2AmdkxVbqToMGiaq6WI2O3ASy7eXklfNSa9SNnxozqW5iXwV7lIGBTkpAaGo26Jm97kzfz4pItMAulC3V5cKFn5R9fG0PTvW8XatoL6XcsmjeBA4Ch33f61vinBOT-_UIHO6ZBA5HOH3SSqeFvo6JAoc_eHvIXio0ClRjdK9klay77SHGkJUWLSxXCvGHWf731MPidwAAAP__Pap7tA) in the months preceding President Kennedy’s assassination, has died at her home in California at the age of 92. In 1963, Paine offered Oswald’s wife and their two daughters a place to stay while he looked for work, and she helped connect him with a job at the Texas School Book Depository in Dallas. Oswald spent the night at her house the night before he shot and killed Kennedy on Nov. 22, 1963, [to retrieve his rifle](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkL1yqzAQhZ8GOjGLzI8pVNyGzrdNySzSCjYRyCOtwX77jJNHSHvOnDPffB-36YYceF_-40ZGnj5OO505kAilycZzjq9MuATKkcPCuIt9SJ406FbBoKCdHHJ4TU3pzAxuqEsydd_20EOtu3I17TDTPFtAbTvXNF3d266hudatdnDtqGTzPoMB2roGDZeKBu2JfN8O16vtEIsGyLHEVMlKQk_MPrziQamycSuDWUXuubj8K_RY6PE8z-rTf1UxLYUebQyBrHDcs8JkVz6o0CN6zw4PFuVjUpnejToxJdx_o_SQVd2Rd8pqjdt7Uybj7ieHwLnriwaWDTn8EMjfvB1GfwcAAP__HR6FLA), which he had wrapped in a package he claimed contained curtains. In the years following the assassination, Paine shared what she knew about Oswald countless times with government investigators, reporters, and scholars, portraying him as a troubled man who “wanted to make a splash.” Despite being vilified by those who questioned the conclusions of the Warren Commission, Paine [insisted Oswald acted alone](https://email.editor.thetexasflyover.com/c/eJykkLGymzAQRb9GdOsRskFQUKShe2lTMgtazCZCcrTrp-e_zzi_8Jpb3bn3zPn1sXwgR073n3jSpF97XhJViaRKZdlyXfNLCO-RJHO8MybdniqLs64DO4LtloAcX8utCdNqw9g2NLW-89bb1vXNMflrh3ZFO-y0rsPN98Pm175bETfv271reHqP2dF2bWudvV5odDvR7rtxGLYe0dwsBdZcLnqQ0hfKHl_5k8ply2cTp0P1Ieb6w7jZuLnWenkUEgl05q2gvlvGze8T42Y7vuNq3CwHQUWBv09WgjXHAOWpBzyQE4FgUoSSBaHmExMoUwDN8Hv_AyiCIpxQOScITAKoMDrj5qZM4VE5Rpbem5u9n8jxP6h-T-_n5P4FAAD__-h-kMc). If you already made your donation last week,THANK YOU so much for rushing in an extra donation to help us- my team is still reviewing all of the records as we speak. But, if not. And given that you maybe weren't checking your emails due to the holiday weekend, I wanted to make sure to follow up with another opportunity to help. Would you mind using this secure link to chip in $5 right now and help us make up the difference between what we had budgeted and what we actually brought in? All year, I've been watching the numbers to see where we stand against the Democrats. That includes everything - polling numbers, registration numbers, turnout numbers, and fundraising numbers... And the ONE thing that keeps me up at night is enthusiasm. Simply put, they 're crushing us. Democrats are turning out a higher number of their own voters than we are. It is a warning to all of us: If they keep this up between now and Election Day, they will beat us in the midterms. subject: I emailed called and texted

body:
I’m not sure what else I can do...

| | | | [](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zlq5hh6l0mhtml5aqf8oat0tjk7l12ej111dt1pg_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ge1o34cdh2bs)
---

I never could have imagined it would get this bad.
But here we are.
Friend – it’s Monica De La Cruz. I have to be blunt with you, but I swear I’m only doing this because it’s absolutely necessary...
I sent texts. I sent emails. I made calls.
I explicitly told you that the Democrats unloaded up to 50 million bucks against me. The attack ads are already hammering the airwaves and I don’t know what else to do.
All this – and STILL no word from you.
Look... maybe you think Democrats could never win Texas. But that couldn’t be further from the truth.
My seat in South Texas was solid blue for over 100 years. With help from patriots like you, we overcame the odds in 2022 and served up a humiliating defeat to the Democrats.
**But this year, they’re out for revenge. The DCCC just listed me as their NUMBER ONE target in the entire state of Texas.**
I don’t have billionaire backers like the Democrats. But I have something better: YOU!
**_[So I’ll ask one more time – can I count on you?](https://e.youramerica.news/rd/9z2zt5vlljj6llaan34r7p8dvmq1um8mvkf4a9ug238_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ge1o34cdh2bs)_**

Hi Peter, Fair representation is at stake right now. We have a president who is pressuring Republicans across the country to pass extreme gerrymanders to rig the 2026 midterm elections. But California is fighting back. Unlike Texas’s extreme, racial gerrymander, California’s proposed map protects the voting power of communities of color and leaves it up to the voters to decide. A.G. Holder breaks down how California is leading the fight against the threat to democracy posed by Donald Trump’s gerrymandering scheme: | “California’s ballot measure stands in stark contrast to Texas’s egregious power grab by doing what Donald Trump and the Republican Party refuse to do: let the damn voters decide. Our democracy is under threat because Republicans fear the judgment of the voters. Trump and his enablers want to insulate themselves from accountability by drawing lines that aim to ignore the will of the people and predetermine their illegitimate victory.” **—Eric H. Holder, Jr.**
82nd Attorney General of the United States
---
“We cannot allow the American people to be cheated out of their rightful voice in our government. That’s why I support responsive, responsible, and temporary measures to ensure the foundations of our democracy are not permanently eroded. What California is doing to meet and balance Texas’s outrageous power grab achieves that purpose, and it has my absolute and total support.”
---
The NDRC is fighting right now to stop Republican power grabs and to ensure the will of the people prevails — in Texas, California, and across the country. ## 🎤 Meet The Soundcheck Fund's First Cohort
We've been talking for a while about the **Soundcheck Fund** --our plan to give independent creators early support to test the mic and fine-tune their message.
Here's the why: if we're going to defeat fascism, the collapsing corporate media model has to give way. Access journalism, monopoly gatekeeping, and cultivated cynicism helped land us here. The Soundcheck Fund exists to build what replaces it.
We're awarding **$500 -$1,000 micro-grants** to creators, storytellers, and digital voices pushing back on extremism and disinformation--and producing original work that informs, agitates, and inspires on the issues that define our democracy. We'll also use our platform to amplify their work.
To our **paid subscribers** : you said you wanted to be part of the solution. **You are.**
Meet our first honorees:
* * *
**[Gabe Sanchez](https://substack.com/redirect/efd45c75-1bba-44ed-ac75-cfecc1444faf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Gabe is the writer-host behind _What Was That?_ , a sharp, satirical news show that cuts through the chaos to make sense of politics. Expect punchy explainers and accountability reporting that land with humor--and receipts.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/ef957a53-0b1f-4d35-8dcc-0d4fa3f1e120?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Check out Gabe's work -> **[https://whatwasthat.show](https://substack.com/redirect/efd45c75-1bba-44ed-ac75-cfecc1444faf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* * *
**[Organizer Memes](https://substack.com/redirect/d2cdaa5d-67cf-4116-8174-612673869c1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Organizer Memes turns breaking news into rapid-response memes that travel fast across the progressive internet--boosting candidates, campaigns, and causes in real time. They also train groups on how to "meme-ify" policy so it actually spreads.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/15c5c68b-2066-4a41-bc61-b339a9f1d71d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Check out Memes' work -> **[https://x.com/OrganizerMemes](https://substack.com/redirect/d2cdaa5d-67cf-4116-8174-612673869c1b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
* * *
**[McKenzie Ortiz](https://substack.com/redirect/68947f6d-d8b4-4642-a259-f60f351efdc0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Pedestrian Pride makes engaging, educational videos that amplify non-drivers and working-class commuters--pushing for safer, more accessible streets. McKenzie creates community-rooted advocacy that meets people where they are and shows what better could look like.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7509f5db-7141-40ab-8dd3-24da92fdf8e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
**[Aurea Bolaños Perea](https://substack.com/redirect/96662a9b-33f1-4038-855a-104ae70a4a06?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Aurea is a Spanish-speaking Latine communicator and reproductive-justice advocate who creates clear, culturally fluent political content--and calls out mis/disinformation targeting her community. Her work blends organizing, media training, and storytelling to move people from fear to action.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/fce734e5-4843-4a35-8bde-45b960081697?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
**[Gina DiVittorio](https://substack.com/redirect/0ee4fcc4-77d6-42a8-b0cc-36e21d7497d6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Gina runs _The Pocket Report_ , a fast, funny, on-your-phone news brief that breaks down politics with wit and clarity--often on location and always on deadline. Think smart explainer journalism with a comedian's timing and a big, loyal audience.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb1d3977-a630-4de5-aa76-ca6f0d57108f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* * *
We're thrilled about this first group--and the next ones coming. We're building an **ecosystem of independent creators**. We've shouted about this for years; now we're doing it. We couldn't do it without your paid subscriptions, which let us keep investing in the program.
Thank you. Together we'll beat the fascist threat and rewrite the rules of modern media. We don't want the old democracy back; we want a stronger, fairer, more just one--and we'll settle for nothing less.

What do YOU think about the new “Tesla tunnel” project in Nashville?
| | | | Can't see this email? [View in Your Browser](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K4CYQVFCFESE5B8H060HSE0Z_0)
---
| | | [ ](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K4CYQVFCFESE5B8H060HSE0Z_1)
---
| | | | Dear Peter, Governor Bill Lee just handed over state-owned property—for free—to Elon Musk’s Boring Company to dig a tunnel under Nashville for a private, unregulated taxi service. No public hearings. No environmental studies. No community outreach. Not a lick of sense! Tennesseans learned of this project _after_ the deal was signed. Now, Lee and his Republican allies are calling it innovation—while residents are left wondering: Is it safe? Who benefits? And why weren’t we consulted?
Yet again, it appears at least one member of the Lee Administration and others politically connected with Bill Lee and Marsha Blackburn have financial interests in the project. We want to know what **you** think—because unlike Governor Lee, we believe in transparency and public input. **🗳️ Take our 1-minute Tesla Tunnel Poll:**
---
| | | | | Do you think the Music City Loop project is necessary for Nashville’s future transportation needs?
---
[Yes – it’s innovative and overdue](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K4CYQVFCFESE5B8H060HSE0Z_2)
[Maybe – we need more studies first](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K4CYQVFCFESE5B8H060HSE0Z_3)
[No – it feels like a vanity project](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K4CYQVFCFESE5B8H060HSE0Z_4)
[Unsure – I need more information](https://ctrk.klclick1.com/l/01K4CYQVFCFESE5B8H060HSE0Z_5)
| Let’s be clear: This tunnel is being drilled in our backyard— _without our voice._ That ends now. — Tennessee House Democratic Caucus

| | **STOP SOROS**
---
Dear Fellow Patriot,Today –- right now -- you and I have our best chance to stop anti-America billionaire and globalist George Soros. **[And it depends on your rapid response to this urgent message – will you sign your STOP SOROS petition right away?](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zb8spqkdnbpe2b19sbds0avol43ig3rh2kbughv0_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs) ** You’re one of America’s most informed seniors, so you know that George Soros has injected his poisonous ideas into every corner of American life: education, media, elections, and our justice system.And the results are disastrous for the nation we love.
---
>> We now have a generation of radicalized young people who hate America and American values. >> George Soros has tentacles everywhere influencing the news and information a majority of Americans see and read. Now he even has majority stake in the second largest radio network in America acquired through a shady Biden FCC deal.>> George Soros’ push for the decriminalization of drugs has led to the worst drug crisis in American history. I hope no one you love has gotten tangled up in this! >> George Soros has hijacked our justice system by channeling millions into electing dozens and dozens of hand-picked radical left District Attorneys.
---
This includes New York’s horrible Letitia James who’s now using every trick in the book to try and stop President Trump and his DOGE efforts. But none of that compares to what George Soros and his heir apparent, Alex Soros, are doing to flood sovereign nations like ours with overwhelming waves of illegal migrants.It’s their way of reshaping our population and setting themselves up as the puppet-masters for all future elections. Their ability to alter entire nations is so potent that Soros’ native country of Hungary passed legislation they call the “Stop Soros Law.”The law made it a crime to aid illegal immigration so Soros couldn’t drown Hungary with illegal migrants in defiance of the government and the will of rightful citizens.That’s exactly the kind of common sense we need here. **[It’s why AMAC Action is spearheading this historic STOP SOROS petition drive – and why I need your name on the petition RIGHT AWAY!](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zh0rnprksn83oq4seeatnjao9ppu2f08smr5i1p0_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs)**
---
[ **STOP SOROS**](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zrcf181ku1iqkda0kd8jfj8k1vfrof6mfohku0sg_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs)
---
Your petition demands that House Speaker Mike Johnson take immediate steps to introduce, advance, and support legislation to neutralize George Soros’ globalist goals. If the Hungarians can get it done, so can we!After the “Stop Soros Law” passed in Hungary, Soros pulled his dark money, equity-seeking, non-governmental organization, the Open Society Foundation, out of Hungary because of the pressure! His open border plans were thwarted.And he turned his attention to us. **Why are we allowing George Soros to sit behind the walls of his sprawling compound in Westchester County, New York, exploiting the wealth he accumulated using our capitalist system...****...to turn our young people, media, elections, and justice system against us??** My fellow patriot, right now the Trump FCC is investigating a Soros-backed radio station that broadcast the live locations of undercover ICE agents who were arriving for deportation operations. **Yes, the George Soros-funded radio station tipped off the criminals!** There are no two ways about it. **_George Soros and his son Alex Soros are enemies of our nation, its people, and our rule of law._** We must make a move against them just like Hungary did.**_And we only have 20 months to do it._** On November 3rd, 2026, Americans head back to the polls for the midterm elections. Chances are good that we’ll lose the House or the Senate –- or both. So to pass legislation, we must move now.Great change comes from embracing great opportunities – and if you want to change this situation where a foreign billionaire is destroying the country we love from within... **[...your signature on your STOP SOROS petition is the greatest opportunity you will have before 20 months is up.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zu3pgb4a1thf6gefhghee0anjipq90kkuhoka000_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs) ****My fellow patriot, my name is Rebecca Weber and I’m the Chairwoman of AMAC Action. ** “AMAC” stands for Association of Mature American Citizens. And when it comes to standing up for the rights of conservative seniors, “action” is what we’re known for.**With its 2 million members, AMAC is the conservative antidote to left-leaning AARP. And our 75 chapters and 300 volunteer delegates makes our advocacy group, AMAC Action, a force to be reckoned with on Capitol Hill.** And unlike the AARP, we’re fighting against George Soros not alongside him.You see, according to public tax filings, over three years, the AARP accepted more than 10 MILLION DOLLARS from the George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.The Tides Foundation says they are on the forefront of “climate justice, racial equity, reproductive freedom” and their mission is “justice and equity.”You know that’s just globalist speak for ‘destroy America and redistribute its power and wealth to radicals.’And listen to this... the AARP once honored George Soros on the cover of their magazine calling him one of “America’s Greatest Innovators” who’s**** “changing the world, $100 million at a time.” It makes my stomach turn to see so many seniors supporting the AARP not knowing it’s under the influence of the radical George Soros-funded Tides Foundation.But today, I’m not writing to those seniors. **[I’m writing to YOU because YOU understand the George Soros threat. And I have faith that you will seize this time-sensitive opportunity to do something about it.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2z34gid15dq8uclbvh7f3hal4oh3sdp9ht6j71gkg_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs) **If the AARP wants to betray America’s seniors by supporting dangerous leftists like George Soros, they are free to do so. **But AMAC Action is leading the charge to bombard Congress with STOP SOROS petitions demanding they introduce, advance, and support legislation to shut-down this dangerous America hater once and for all.**** ****And we would be honored to have you by our side.** **[Please sign your STOP SOROS petition right away, and make a one-time contribution of $35 to help AMAC Action collect and send the millions of petitions we’ll need in the next 20 months.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2zhhs71tiedha3bmgqu4aa1ctarm4t2v14s6drc9o_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs) ** AMAC Action doesn’t take a dime of taxpayer funding. And we’re certainly not bought and paid for by George Soros or any of his dark money groups like the Tides Foundation.Our funding comes from grassroots conservatives like you who care deeply about the future of America.We answer to you -- not to George and Alex Soros. With that said, if you’re able to make a larger emergency gift of $50, $75, $100, $150, $250, $500, or even $1,000 -- please do it.**[We have a lot of work to do to STOP SOROS and time is not on our side.](http://e.nationalrepublicanpolling.com/rd/9z2ze6l9oi9l9c03hlcfgg96qmjjv3t4u9dckodertg_rp22sh2s8i6epb7c1ie8or6chh2bs) **Thank you for joining us in this fight for America.
---
| | For Freedom,
---
**Rebecca Weber,_Chairwoman_****AMAC Action**

A former Vice President of State Farm, Haden Kirkpatrick, **has filed a new lawsuit against me**.

Let me be blunt: **This is LAWFARE designed to shut us down and kill undercover investigative journalism.**

Yes, I'm frustrated. You should be, too. **Lawfare is a tool used by cowards**. It's a tactic to use big-money attorneys to bully and silence.

But they don't realize that they're just not taking on me:

**They're taking on US** if you choose to stand firm beside me
and **never back down, never settle, and never give up**.

[**Stand beside me today and donate to my legal defense fund to help offset the costs of this litigation**designed to STOP ME****](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1656241/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLXN1ZWQtYWdhaW4tbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MDU/LbmNsRW04U2pwbA/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctc3VlZC1hZ2FpbiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZhbW91bnQ9MjUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjE0MTFfd3Ix/gaLrkFg/s4ge0ef5db9)**.**

Since when has a journalist ever been told the truth when a camera is pointed in their face? You know that answer.

**The truth is only exposed if they THINK they won’t get caught**.

That's why OMG is so effective. We record the raw, unfiltered truth, no matter how dark it may be, and bring it to the light.

And these lawsuits won't stop until we win and show them that any effort to kill our work, WILL fail!

**[**Stand with me. [**I'd like your help to fight this out by donating to our legal defense fund with Liberty Guard.**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1656241/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLXN1ZWQtYWdhaW4tbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MDU/LbmNsRW04U2pwbA/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctc3VlZC1hZ2FpbiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZhbW91bnQ9MjUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjE0MTFfd3Ix/gaLrkFg/s4ge0ef5db9) We have to hire another legal team to **respond to this lawsuit within 21 days of being served.**

So I have a short window of time to come up with what I expect to be a $30,000 retainer.

[**Any amount you can donate will chip away at that huge a**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1656241/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLXN1ZWQtYWdhaW4tbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MDU/LbmNsRW04U2pwbA/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctc3VlZC1hZ2FpbiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZhbW91bnQ9MjUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjE0MTFfd3Ix/gaLrkFg/s4ge0ef5db9)mount. With the help of hundreds of other Americans who want us to continue our work, we can hit that goal.

Help me show them that when they go for my throat, [**they have to go through an army of Americans like you before they can even get within reach**](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.com/click/e1656241/VaHR0cHM6Ly9zZWN1cmUuYW5lZG90LmNvbS9saWJlcnR5LWd1YXJkL2xnLXN1ZWQtYWdhaW4tbWItb20v/SZW1haWxfYW1lcmljYU9ORXN0d2Fycm9vbV9jb20yNTA5MDU/LbmNsRW04U2pwbA/qP3V0bV9zb3VyY2U9bGctc3VlZC1hZ2FpbiZ1dG1fbWVkaXVtPW9tJnV0bV9jYW1wYWlnbj1tYiZhbW91bnQ9MjUmdXRtX3Rlcm09MjE0MTFfd3Ix/gaLrkFg/s4ge0ef5db9).

Thank you so much for all that you do.

In Truth,
James O’Keefe

| Letter from the Chair
---
Nothing is more iconic America than the State Fair. Nebraska's State Fair in Grand Island last week was such an enjoyable experience for me. The NEGOP fair booth was active all week long with the Test your Constitutional Knowledge Game and Husker Ticket raffle being two popular activities. NEGOP Director of Governmental Relations Jeanne Reigle and I worked shifts on Thursday and Friday together.
Jeanne and I were able to attend Senator Pete Ricketts' forum on Friday featuring Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) Secretary Lee Zeldin and Senator Dr. John Barasso (R-Wy). Nebraska Farm Bureau President Mark McHargue moderated a portion of the program and Nebraska Chamber of Commerce President Todd Bingham moderated another portion. It occurred to me how we Nebraskans often take for granted how accessible our elected officials are to the people.
Later that day Senator Ricketts stopped by the NEGOP fair booth to say "hello." He noted our carved cutouts of President Trump and Vice President JD Vance used by passersby for photographs. Senator Ricketts and I shared a good laugh when I mentioned that I had met and been photographed with JD Vance at the previous week's Republican National Committee (RNC) meeting in Atlanta. Vice President Vance asked me if my last name was really Truemper. "Yes", I said, "you've heard of "never-Trumpers", but I'm a "forever Truemper"!
Young and old participated in the NEGOP fair booth's Constitutional Knowledge challenge. Prizes were awarded to those with correct answers and multiple chances to win were offered. Many people signed up for the Husker Ticket raffle and often muttered that there was no way that they would win. We did indeed have four winners drawn and now three of them have their tickets in hand.
Many thanks go out to last week's volunteers, candidates, and officeholders who manned the booth, but mostly to Hall County GOP Chairman and NEGOP Treasurer David Plond who organized another good experience for us at the State Fair. Looking forward to next year already!

Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party
