2. Stay Engaged
To protect democracy, we all must stay engaged day in and day out. We can’t just show up right before an election and tune out afterward. If we remain committed, democracy will win.
Check out a Montgomery County Commissioner’s effort to educate voters. It's now an emmy-nominated short film. “Running elections in Pennsylvania's third-most-populous county, Neil Makhija said he’s seen the slippery slope from election misinformation to political violence.” ( Philadelphia Inquirer [https://www.inquirer.com/politics/pennsylvania/montgomery-county-commissioner-neil-makhija-emmy-20250508.html] )
3. Share What You Learn
Once you’ve figured out what’s going on, share that information with your networks and community. It might feel awkward to bring up voter suppression or changes in election laws when we’re not in the middle of a major election — but local elections happen in off years, and special elections are more common than you think. Now is the perfect time to start conversations about voting.
Here, in Pennsylvania, we vote every year, twice a year!
4. Join or Support Pro-Democracy Organizations
Is partisan politics not for you? There are numerous nonprofits and grassroots organizations working every day to protect voting rights and ensure free and fair elections. Supporting these groups with your time or resources helps these groups do their work.
Check out the work New PA Project has been up to lately below. AND , check out our upcoming events listed above!
5. Become a Trained Poll Worker
Many counties face a shortage of poll workers, especially during election season. Being a poll worker requires dedication, attention to detail and a willingness to be trained. It’s a meaningful way to serve your community and help protect the integrity of the voting process.
Here are some resources that may be helpful:
Pennsylvania Capital-Star - Advocacy groups offer training for Pa. primary poll watchers [https://penncapital-star.com/briefs/advocacy-groups-offer-training-for-pa-primary-poll-watchers/]
Spotlight PA - Election 2025: How to become a poll worker for the PA primary [https://www.spotlightpa.org/news/2025/04/pennsylvania-primary-election-2025-how-to-be-poll-worker-guide/]
Franklin County Free Press - Poll Workers Needed for Pennsylvania’s 2025 Primary Election [https://fcfreepresspa.com/poll-workers-needed-for-pennsylvanias-2025-primary-election/]
6. Engage Your Elected Officials
Call and write your elected officials at the federal, state and local levels. Tell them that protecting voting rights and ensuring free and fair elections are your top priorities. Even better, show up at public meetings. Ask them directly what they’re doing to combat voter suppression. Be informed about pending legislation and urge them to support pro-democracy initiatives. This applies no matter where you live or who represents you — Democrat or Republican. Constituent pressure always matters. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise.
7. Vote in Every Election
Yes — every election. That means local elections, primary elections and special elections. Become a super-voter. The more you vote, the more informed and engaged you become. You’ll also be better positioned to notice and report problems — like changes to polling locations or voting equipment — that could impact turnout or accessibility.
Make a plan to vote in the primary election, Tuesday, May 20th. When are you voting this year? Who are you going with? How are you voting this year -- by mail or on Election Day? As a reminder, the last day to request a mail ballot is Tuesday, May 13th!

Earlier this week, the PA [] House State Government Committee [] [] voted on two bills that have the potential to impact our voting rights: State Rep Mehaffie's Voter ID bill (HB771) and State Rep. McClinton's omnibus bill (HB1396). Both passed out of committee this week and will now be voted on by the full house. An omnibus bill is a legislative bill that combines multiple, sometimes unrelated, provisions or bills into one single bill. It's essentially a package deal of different legislative proposals, often used to facilitate the passage of legislation, particularly appropriations bills. HB 771 is sponsored by State Rep. Thomas Mehaffie (Dauphin) and “would require all voters arriving at their election precincts to show identification or attest under penalty of law that they are legally able to vote in Pennsylvania.” State Rep. Malcolm Kenyatta (Philadelphia) voiced his opposition to the bill. Let’s talk about the issues that do exist. This legislation doesn’t address those.” HB 1396 has a more recognizable name behind it – Speaker of the State House Joanna McClinton (Delaware/Philadelphia). State Rep. Ben Waxman (Philadelphia) complemented the Speaker, saying that the legislation is a “comprehensive approach to election reform that tries to dramatically improve the process and makes administration of elections much smoother.” Among other changes, [] House Bill 1396 would also give election workers up to a week before Election Day to prepare to count mail-in ballots, a process that has been a bottleneck for election results in parts of the state, providing fodder for election deniers. Being a poll worker requires dedication, attention to detail and a willingness to be trained. It’s a meaningful way to serve your community and help protect the integrity of the voting process. Here are some resources that may be helpful: Pennsylvania Capital-Star - Advocacy groups offer training for Pa. primary poll watchers [] Spotlight PA - Election 2025: How to become a poll worker for the PA primary [] Franklin County Free Press - Poll Workers Needed for Pennsylvania’s 2025 Primary Election [] 6. Engage Your Elected Officials Call and write your elected officials at the federal, state and local levels. Tell them that protecting voting rights and ensuring free and fair elections are your top priorities. Even better, show up at public meetings. Ask them directly what they’re doing to combat voter suppression. Be informed about pending legislation and urge them to support pro-democracy initiatives. This applies no matter where you live or who represents you — Democrat or Republican. Constituent pressure always matters. Don’t let anyone tell you otherwise. 7. Vote in Every Election Yes — every election. That means local elections, primary elections and special elections. Become a super-voter. The more you vote, the more informed and engaged you become. You’ll also be better positioned to notice and report problems — like changes to polling locations or voting equipment — that could impact turnout or accessibility. Make a plan to vote in the primary election, Tuesday, May 20th. When are you voting this year? Who are you going with? How are you voting this year -- by mail or on Election Day? As a reminder, the last day to request a mail ballot is Tuesday, May 13th! Recent Events [] Solidarity for Immigrants On Monday, May 5th, also Cinco de Mayo, over 300 people, representing 18 community organizations from across Pennsylvania, gathered at the State Capitol in Harrisburg to rally for immigrant rights. We amplified voices that have been silenced, advocated against injustice, and showed that solidarity is not just a word—it is a force that creates change. This event was a declaration that Pennsylvania stands against injustice and division. [] [] [] NPPEF on the Ground [] Last Monday, May 5th was the last day to register to vote for the primary election! Our teams were out in their communities leading up to the voter registration deadline on Monday. We helped folks ensure they have the ability to exercise their right to vote in the primary on Tuesday, May 20th. Our teams are currently getting ready for GOTV - a time of year where we are on the ground connecting with our communities and mobilizing them to vote. It's our favorite time of year to build relationships with those we hope to uplift. Dauphin County [] [] Delaware County [] [] Luzerne County [] [] Super voters vote twice a year, every year ! Thank you for doing your part to stay informed and engaged! subject: Trump’s DOJ is now a political hit squad
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Dan Goldman for New York**
body:

#
---
Donald Trump has always put himself _above_ the law, Peter. Now, he is using the law for political revenge and retribution. He has installed his former defense lawyers to run the Department of Justice, and they are treating the DOJ as Trump’s personal law firm, using the awesome power of the federal government to go after his enemies. During my 10 years in the Department of Justice under former Presidents Bush and Obama, the White House never requested that the DOJ conduct any criminal investigations; in fact, the DOJ’s policy is to neither confirm nor deny even the _existence_ of an investigation. But under this administration, Trump has actually issued Executive Orders directing the DOJ to criminally investigate individuals whose only apparent “crime” was to previously speak out against him:
* **Chris Krebs** , who was in charge of election integrity for the Department of Homeland Security in 2020 and said the election was the most secure in history; and
* **Miles Taylor** , a senior Trump administration employee who authored an op-ed and book critical of Trump.

The DOJ has also rehired Ed Martin, a “Stop the Steal” activist and Jan. 6 supporter who was deemed to be too extreme to be confirmed by even the Republican-led Senate for the top prosecutor role in D.C., and who has been asked to investigate other political enemies. Martin has publicly released letters confirming the existence of criminal investigations — a DOJ no-no — and requesting the resignations of public officials simply due to the existence of his nakedly political investigation. The names of those under investigation will not surprise you:
* **NY Attorney General Letitia James** , who brought a civil lawsuit that resulted in a judge finding Trump liable for cooking his company’s books;
* **Senator Adam Schiff** , who led the first impeachment of Trump (with me as his counsel);
* **Jack Smith** , the Special Counsel who investigated and indicted Trump twice – once for conspiring to overturn the 2020 election and another time for obtaining, holding and concealing classified information;
* **John Bolton** , Trump’s former national security adviser who has been critical of Trump; and
* **Lisa Cook** , a Fed Governor who has not heeded Trump’s demands to lower interest rates.

**This is not normal. This is not justice. This is the weaponization of the criminal justice system for partisan ends.** Throughout my career as a prosecutor and as Democrats’ lead counsel during Trump’s first impeachment, I have fought to hold people in power accountable for breaking the law and abusing their power. That is what’s needed more than ever right now. We must shine a light on these abuses, expose them for what they are, and ensure that our justice system serves the people — not a president or his political allies. **[If you’re with me, I hope you’ll chip in to power my work to hold this corrupt administration accountable today:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/114670081/567774766/2132766433?refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250905_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTIwMmNkNi02YzhhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DB_mA_11kLAIeY-HnWM4Y_GefBhF0XVmB1B1ER2_cp8=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | [CHIP IN $10 NOW](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/114670082/567774794/2132766433?express_lane=true&amount=10&refcode=AU_DSG_FR_GEN_GEN_AC_20250905_PM1_V1_S1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzEvMS85NDA4NyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwNTIwMmNkNi02YzhhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DB_mA_11kLAIeY-HnWM4Y_GefBhF0XVmB1B1ER2_cp8=)

Before I decided to run, I had the privilege of serving Pennsylvanians under Senator Casey and Governor Wolf. I’ll tell you more about that in just a moment, but if you’re ready to help me continue fighting for our communities in Washington, I hope you’ll [_**make a donation to my campaign today.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/114670628/567776479/1877634325?refcode=BLU_EM_CODC_2025-09-05_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc2MjgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTJjNjRkOGItNmQ4YS1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NMH0lxoX3wDTlTowQaIBnqdQvjjDwqa1ldX1GPqpnkE=)

In 2011, Senator Bob Casey asked me to be his Regional Manager in Lehigh, Northampton, Carbon, and Berks Counties, and I served as his Statewide Latino Affairs Advisor. I worked one-on-one with thousands of people in our community, connecting them to services that made a real difference in their lives. I went to bat for them, and I’m proud to have delivered results.
[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/114670630/567776486/1877634325?refcode=BLU_EM_CODC_2025-09-05_1&amount=25&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNjIvMS8xMTc2MjgiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiNTJjNjRkOGItNmQ4YS1mMDExLWI0ODQtNjA0NWJkZWI3NDEzIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=NMH0lxoX3wDTlTowQaIBnqdQvjjDwqa1ldX1GPqpnkE=)
A few years later, I joined Governor Tom Wolf’s Advisory Commission on Latino Affairs, representing the Lehigh Valley. I pushed for policies that truly supported working families and advocated for our community’s needs at the highest level of state government.

I’ve seen firsthand how important it is to listen to people, understand their struggles, and take action to make life better for them. And now, I’m running for Congress because I believe PA-07 deserves someone who shows up, listens, and actually gets things done.

clean_body: I wanted to share a little bit about my journey and why I’m running for Congress. | = | Hi Peter, I wanted to share a little bit about my journey and why I’m running for Congress. Before I decided to run, I had the privilege of serving Pennsylvanians under Senator Casey and Governor Wolf. I’ll tell you more about that in just a moment, but if you’re ready to help me continue fighting for our communities in Washington, I hope you’ll = | | | = In 2011, Senator Bob Casey asked me to be his Regional Manager in Lehigh, Northampton, Carbon, and Berks Counties, and I served as his Statewide Latino Affairs Advisor. I worked one-on-one with thousands of people in our community, connecting them to services that made a real difference in their lives. I went to bat for them, and I’m proud to have delivered results. = A few years later, I joined Governor Tom Wolf’s Advisory Commission on Latino Affairs, representing the Lehigh Valley. I pushed for policies that truly supported working families and advocated for our community’s needs at the highest level of state government. I’ve seen firsthand how important it is to listen to people, understand their struggles, and take action to make life better for them. And now, I’m running for Congress because I believe PA-07 deserves someone who shows up, listens, and actually gets things done. But here’s the thing: This race is going to take everything we’ve got. subject: An AIPAC candidate vs. a pro-human rights candidate
body:
Our newest endorsement is taking on AIPAC in CA-34.
#
Hey Peter,
The Democratic primary fight in California’s 34th district is a big one between AIPAC-backed incumbent Rep. Jimmy Gomez and pro-human rights candidate Angela Gonzales-Torres.
Angela is Justice Democrats’ newest 2026 endorsement, and we couldn’t be more proud to support her at a time when we desperately need more members of Congress willing to stand up and speak out against genocide.
Last cycle, **her opponent was one of the top 5 recipients of AIPAC Super PAC spending, receiving $2.3 million** — in a cycle where they spent over $100 million to undermine our democracy.
And it paid off: Jimmy refused to cosponsor the only bill in Congress that called for a ceasefire in Gaza, and repeatedly voted to arm the Israeli military with the bombs and weapons they are using to commit a genocide against Palestinians.
**Unlike Jimmy, Angela won’t take a penny from AIPAC (or the other many lobbies that fund Jimmy’s campaign, like crypto super PACs or real estate developers).** Instead, she’ll listen to the majority of Democratic voters in CA-34 and nationwide, sign on to the bill calling for a ceasefire, and support the Block the Bombs Act to stop the U.S. from sending more weapons to Israel’s government.
**[But if she’s going to win against a corporate, corrupt incumbent with AIPAC’s billionaire-megadonor network behind him, she needs YOUR support today. Can we count on you to pitch in $5 directly to Angela’s campaign?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jd-em-20250905-1-at?refcode=em20250905-36991&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&refcode2=36991_1203867_m67Qz7&akid=36991%2E1203867%2Em67Qz7)**

Thanks for all you do,
Geoff Simpson
Campaigns Director

So many kind souls like you have asked how I’m doing, so I wanted to personally update you on my recovery.

I was hospitalized after a devastating car crash. We were struck by a vehicle going what felt like 70-80 miles per hour. Had I not been wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed.
---
Right now, a back brace is holding my fractured spine together.
---
But if I could survive being arrested in the most violent jail in America, I know I can survive **__ANYTHING!__**

[](https://link.email.america1stwarroom.)

---
One thing especially helped take the pain away...
---
...**President Trump has announced that he will award me with the Presidential Medal of Freedom – _the highest civilian honor in America._**
---

---
**Left with no pardon, no safety net, and no lifeline, my _ONLY_ chance at walking free is to secure a top-notch defense team.**
---
But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of **BANKRUPTCY**.
---
**And now, this car crash has set me back even more...**
---
And so, my last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my life is patriots like _YOU_.
---
That’s why I’m making a final plea to humbly ask that you contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust as I continue fighting for my _FREEDOM_ and my _JUSTICE_.

__Because when President Trump places the Medal of Freedom around my neck, I want history to always remember that I FOUGHT for my freedom and justice until the VERY END!__

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: Are we a party that rallies behind our nominee or not?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
For the good of the party, we must put our differences aside and support our party’s nominee.
#
We have a Democratic nominee for Mayor of New York City: Zohran Mamdani.
Are we a party that rallies behind our nominee or not?
I supported Joe Biden when he was the nominee — he was not my preferred candidate in the primary. I, of course, supported Vice President Harris for the presidency.
Because I am a Democrat. Because we use our primaries to settle our differences, and once we have a nominee, _we rally behind that nominee._
**We must set the example of supporting the party’s nominee.**
If an individual doesn’t want to support the party’s nominee now, it complicates their ability to ask voters to support any nominee later — whether that is mayoral, presidential, or what have you.
For the good of the party, we must put our differences aside and support our party’s nominee.
This isn’t about ‘personalities.’ We’re in a moment of a Trump administration where the stakes are high. I want our party to come together and stick together, despite our differences.
We will need to push harder than ever to elect progressives like Zohran in elections around the country, at every level of government.
[ Will you split a $5 contribution — $2.50 for this campaign and $2.50 for Courage to Change, our leadership PAC advocating for those progressives — today so we can keep pushing forward?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20250905-ctc.smT0bq&refcode=em20250905-9690-P_FND_EGR_CTC&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=9690%2E2526796%2EK98gwE)

In solidarity,
Alexandria

name: Carolina, United We Dream
subject: Eight years ago, DACA nearly ended
body:
Fear has never stopped us, and it won’t stop us now. | | | Peter — **Eight years ago,** Jeff Sessions attempted to end DACA, calling it illegal and unconstitutional. DACA is right and legal, and it has helped hundreds of thousands of young people finish school, apply for a work permit, and be protected from deportation. **Eight years ago,** our communities stepped up to send a message that our home is here, _and those efforts are what kept our fight for DACA alive and thriving._ Hundreds of thousands of undocumented people, young people, and workers bravely stood up and refused to be ignored. Together, we’ve faced attacks united with courage to create a better future for everyone, where we can all be free to thrive. **No matter the efforts to silence and crush us, we’re not going anywhere. We know what our people need, and we’re organizing our communities to continue to fight for DACA and permanent protections for immigrant youth.** ****[**Please, fuel that fight with an $8 donation today:**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeHd1VIQvbrJiu_yCLbM7G-x2Hj8NqlRfrkMpGW750OCNrskuNbJUaYJgLgLPW9aSWydiFQ6I_kAntVLRA6U9wL4v729JOZVnwu23f8tJUK6jv4bdBg9oCd7QlTD8t7ePgaMinAW0cT5GMJ5ZTeWmX7DQYQZrY_B6pJ5YwLCVhwjB6EkJWu0pJUIDvCfn0v_NHeHvDX3PNkx5uPk-ljVa0y4WJzOTHbE_FUiocgfbgL8WoKq3B51yBWcUQ3-FWnDQto6NC5sjJI_lG3zSdqCcbvghXOGLo1If6yLyy1olQ1z9srD2rJZO6D11cxd4xadMWxQHXE_9yYlIvti0cxltzHNzl-A5brIoNe1H88U1hoNNhw7CobMflF60GaGylE-62SaAyBvz1Bc_93MxJusJ1XdZAS3FPsPiH8t4X-FwN42jQ53j6frdVL4AxmFVabZY_bMaO68lY4N7cF8wbouim9Q/4jn/bPvmE9OrSRCzL8Go2feZ5g/h0/h001.3cj5JKAK3TkWKLKPX_trdXO07JVvmLWvIogYZxUDxzA) _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | | | [express donate: $8](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqswjENXoYacFGtlMLXh6NAeHd1VIQvbrJiu_yCLbM7G-x2Hj8NqlRfrkMpGW750OCNrskuNbJUaYJgLgLPW9aSWjmlCaTVWHlnbRkH9LpLRSFDnQC34mWVS12ZHpbfcGkInMp3psVxxiGk3OWC22B24NrCuLd_ey5dTaZwFZl3PfLSR--wZEKl8EWV1Uf5O569CbDU3mxds-iiqK6tayuggUmqbV6oEkC9kB-xjF5SprLmaLINrquKxRPJKsN3SCggFRHn_Ydau0T4hHgzPZ2TJy4jUFZhABBRwD-721-IPGrofT1bcLOZvWyFAQB1n3Th9ACH_eO4GMEL-WeDk17Q8pk9PxiECOMmSQBH5TUXeOixb0mZwA4WOKpU9Yt8MdgFLwZmRaKJEGwgstw3OIpCf01lxgbH-MxWEJge2qapYBOFQDNPTX8tKbRpzRp39my7z1KPBIsgjlYsFvj-2I3b4ESm_d7Dux1O-G5xRQtjgI5P8hv3PzW5-sIfL0p7pMZI/4jn/bPvmE9OrSRCzL8Go2feZ5g/h1/h001.hhbgL70Fv-_hKocD-d83YRzwt0hZUp11WPrfbk3G6cs)

clean_body: Fear has never stopped us, and it won’t stop us now. | | | Peter — Eight years ago, Jeff Sessions attempted to end DACA, calling it illegal and unconstitutional. DACA is right and legal, and it has helped hundreds of thousands of young people finish school, apply for a work permit, and be protected from deportation. Eight years ago, our communities stepped up to send a message that our home is here, and those efforts are what kept our fight for DACA alive and thriving. Hundreds of thousands of undocumented people, young people, and workers bravely stood up and refused to be ignored. Together, we’ve faced attacks united with courage to create a better future for everyone, where we can all be free to thrive. No matter the efforts to silence and crush us, we’re not going anywhere. We know what our people need, and we’re organizing our communities to continue to fight for DACA and permanent protections for immigrant youth. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | | | | | | | | | | The respective merchants of record for transactions to United We Dream Network are ActBlue Charities Inc. Now, I didn't hold back in my interview with Lawrence, and I won't with you either.
**Donald Trump has devastated Virginia's economy, but my opponent won't stop cheering him on.**
Winsome Earle-Sears has said Trump's tax law does "so many great things," and just the other day, she lied to Jake Tapper about cuts to healthcare.
The data is clear: 350,000 Virginians are projected to lose healthcare coverage and rural hospitals are set to close due to the so-called "Big, Beautiful Bill." Everyday goods are skyrocketing due to Trump's tariffs, and thousands of our civil servants are now unemployed due to DOGE.
_The Bureau of Labor Statistics just announced that Virginia lost more than 43,000 jobs earlier this year._ And our unemployment rate has ticked up for seven straight months. _(The last time that happened was the 2008 financial crisis.)_

Peter, it's Valerie –** ** There are times in our nation’s history where inaction becomes a form of action. Congress’ failure to address our country’s gun violence epidemic is one of our gravest failures. We do not lack solutions. We lack the political courage. There is no community in North Carolina or across the country that has not been impacted by the devastation of gun violence. Millions of parents, children, and neighbors live with a fear that has become all too familiar.**It doesn’t have to be this way. ** No one should fear sending their child to school, attending a place of worship, or simply going to the grocery store. **We have the tools to address gun violence — what we need now is the political courage to act. ** As a member of the House Gun Violence Prevention Task Force, I’ve been proud to help lead efforts to reinstate the federal assault weapons ban and advance meaningful, commonsense gun safety legislation. We can’t allow another tragedy to be met with empty statements and no action. Not when lives are on the line and when every day of inaction puts more families at risk. # CBS to buy The Free Press for $200m and liberals are losing their minds
Liberals erupted in outrage as Paramount's new CEO David Ellison nears a $200 million deal to **[buy Bari Weiss' The Free Press](https://substack.com/redirect/2dda3f3b-2ea7-4be0-8da5-3bbd5d901961?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**, potentially installing the polarizing journalist in a top CBS News role.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2dda3f3b-2ea7-4be0-8da5-3bbd5d901961?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Weiss ' Controversial Background:** Bari Weiss, who left The New York Times in 2020 citing a hostile "illiberal environment," founded The Free Press, which challenges DEI, gender ideology, and pro-Palestinian narratives.
* **Ellison 's Strategic Move:** Paramount's David Ellison, fresh off an $8 billion Skydance merger, aims to revamp struggling CBS News by leveraging Weiss' anti-woke perspective to boost ratings.
* **Mixed CBS Reactions:** Some CBS News staff praise Weiss' critique of legacy media, while others fear her pro-Israel stance could spark internal conflict, especially over Gaza coverage.
* **Liberal Social Media Backlash:** Critics like Taylor Lorenz and Hasan Piker slammed the move, accusing Weiss of pushing a right-wing and pro-Israel agenda, with some calling CBS News' shift a credibility risk.

# Melania Trump urges responsible AI growth to tech titans
First Lady Melania Trump speaking to top tech leaders, including Google CEO Sundar Pichai, at the White House Thursday, championed **[responsible AI growth](https://substack.com/redirect/f5afc107-a65e-472e-bb15-94d80665c609?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to shape America's future, blending innovation with caution.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/c39720a0-7ab3-4749-8b89-9c25b3b98ebf?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Task Force Advances Education:** The White House Task Force on AI Education, meeting for the second time, secured over 135 pledges from tech leaders to bolster AI literacy nationwide.
* **Presidential AI Challenge Launched:** Melania Trump's August initiative invites K-12 students to use AI for community solutions, culminating in a White House event for winners.
* **Be Best Initiative Continues:** The First Lady's advocacy for child online safety, through her Be Best campaign, includes supporting the Take It Down Act against AI-generated explicit imagery.
* **Tech Titans Dine Later:** President Trump hosted a Rose Garden dinner with tech giants like Mark Zuckerberg and Tim Cook, following the AI meeting, to discuss industry advancements.

* * *
* * *
# Musk's latest pay deal with Tesla could make him the worlds first Trillionaire
Tesla's board unveiled a **[staggering $975 billion compensation plan](https://substack.com/redirect/9ea117db-d31b-45c8-a4a4-06414e271564?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** for CEO Elon Musk, potentially making him the world's first trillionaire if shareholders approve and the company hits ambitious milestones by 2035.
[](https://substack.com/redirect/ce8a22e1-e0a4-4a5a-9ed9-9eb1cca444fa?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* **Massive Share Award** : The proposed plan grants Musk over 423 million shares, significantly boosting his 13% stake and voting power in Tesla if market cap and operational goals are met.
* **Ambitious Performance Targets** : Musk must nearly double Tesla's market cap to $2 trillion for the first award, with final goals including $8.5 trillion and milestones like 20 million vehicles delivered.
* **xAI Investment Vote** : Shareholders will vote November 6 on Tesla investing in Musk's AI venture, xAI, raising questions about potential conflicts of interest amid his multiple business ventures.
* **Legal Battle Context** : The new plan follows a Delaware court ruling voiding Musk's $56 billion 2018 package, with Tesla's appeal ongoing and Musk's political activities impacting the company's reputation.

* * *
* * *
# Lawmakers are closer than ever to ban Congressional stock trading
Lawmakers are intensifying efforts to **[ban congressional stock trading,](https://substack.com/redirect/18ae4459-65bb-48fd-8485-d7ade5b9b6a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** hoping strategic policy tweaks will finally curb conflicts of interest, as bipartisan support grows amid public outcry over ethical concerns.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/18ae4459-65bb-48fd-8485-d7ade5b9b6a6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Bipartisan Support Grows:** A diverse coalition of lawmakers, including Sens. Jon Ossoff and Gary Peters, backs the ban, aiming to restore public trust in Congress.
* **Policy Faces Hurdles:** Critics argue the ban could unfairly limit lawmakers' financial freedom, potentially stalling the bill despite recent momentum.
* **Public Pressure Mounts:** High-profile scandals involving lawmakers' trades have fueled voter demands for stricter ethics rules in Congress.
* **Strategic Compromises Proposed:** Supporters are open to adjusting penalties and disclosure rules to navigate political opposition and secure passage.

## Watch Related Video:
### **Asking Wall St. traders "Did you beat Nancy Pelosi's stock portfolio?"**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/6a6cb0d5-67b4-4b48-9b9a-50f3442d0f29?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* * *
* * *
# Americans are done with "Guilt-tipping"
Americans are **[pushing back against "guilt tipping"](https://substack.com/redirect/3c707e0b-08e5-42f1-951e-9efcfb844751?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** at digital checkouts, slashing tip spending by 38% in 2025 as social pressure from screens prompts resentment and calls for fairer wages.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/3c707e0b-08e5-42f1-951e-9efcfb844751?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Tipping Pressure Sparks Backlash:** About 20% of Americans tip more due to guilt, but 29% resist, feeling pressured by digital screens, with 37% noting higher suggested tip amounts.
* **Economic Factors Curb Tipping:** Rising living costs led nearly half of surveyed Americans to reduce tipping, with many believing businesses should pay employees better instead of relying on tips.
* **Guilt Tipping Costs Add Up:** On average, Americans spend $283 yearly on reluctant tips, averaging $24 monthly, driven by awkwardness or fear of judgment at checkout.
* **New Law Offers Relief:** The One Big Beautiful Bill Act, effective 2025-2028, allows tipped workers to deduct up to $25,000 in tips from taxable income, covering over 60 jobs.

* * *
* * *
# Gold is surging and this is what is driving it to all time highs
Gold prices **[soared to a record $3,587](https://substack.com/redirect/25722ae1-d585-40ee-b5e2-b9331b996fd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** per troy ounce Friday in London, driven by central bank buying and investor fears over U.S. trade wars and Federal Reserve independence concerns.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/25722ae1-d585-40ee-b5e2-b9331b996fd0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Central Banks Boost Demand** : Annual net gold purchases by central banks have surpassed 1,000 metric tons since 2022, with 900 tons expected in 2025, doubling the 2016-2021 average.
* **Jewelry Demand Plummets** : High prices cut gold jewelry demand by 14% to 341 tons in Q2 2025, the lowest since Q3 2020, with China and India leading the decline.
* **Retail Investment Shifts** : Gold bar purchases rose 10% in 2024, while coin buying fell 31%, with Asia's high demand driving a 2% net physical investment increase in 2025.
* **ETFs Gain Traction** : Gold ETFs saw 397 tons of inflows from January to June 2025, the largest first-half gain since 2020, with holdings at 3,615.9 tons by June's end.

body:
Congress is back in session with much to do before the midterms - If we don’t win, President Trump’s agenda is DOA

| | | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/40ecb507aedc/welcome-to-team-grantham-10141056?e=0b767f7f9d)

| | | | | | Friend,
Congress returns to Washington with much to do, yet Democrats are dragging their feet. Why? Democrats are betting on Republicans losing the House in the midterms, effectively ending the President’s agenda. President Trump has had a great first eight months, but if we are unsuccessful next November, it may mean the end of his domestic policy agenda.
So Democrats are digging in to slow or stop everything from spending cuts to border security and election reform. And as we approach the new year, lawmakers in Washington will begin to think more about the 2026 midterms than getting their job done. Historically, the party in the White House has not fared well in the midterms, and Democrats would love nothing more than to end President Trump’s agenda early.
That's why races like ours matter. In politics, time flies fast, and time could be running out on our ability to seize the opportunity Americans gave us last November. We need to hold the House to deliver on as many of President Trump’s promises to the American people as possible.
I have fought for the values of conservative Arizonans and won! And I'll do the same in the U.S. Congress. We have an opportunity to deliver real solutions to the American people, and winning the upcoming midterms will go a long way toward ensuring we deliver the “America First” agenda!

Why? Democrats are betting on Republicans losing the House in the midterms, effectively ending the President’s agenda. President Trump has had a great first eight months, but if we are unsuccessful next November, it may mean the end of his domestic policy agenda. So Democrats are digging in to slow or stop everything from spending cuts to border security and election reform. And as we approach the new year, lawmakers in Washington will begin to think more about the 2026 midterms than getting their job done. Historically, the party in the White House has not fared well in the midterms, and Democrats would love nothing more than to end President Trump’s agenda early. That's why races like ours matter. In politics, time flies fast, and time could be running out on our ability to seize the opportunity Americans gave us last November. We need to hold the House to deliver on as many of President Trump’s promises to the American people as possible. I have fought for the values of conservative Arizonans and won! We wanted to make sure you saw Brianna’s message below, – Team Titone \----- Original Message ----- Hi Peter, I have spent my life committed to supporting my community. I learned the value of service at such a young age. At sixteen, I began volunteering as a firefighter at my local fire department. I was so passionate about this service, that I drove to all of the fire departments I could to get all the relevant certifications. I took every class that I could and gained 200 hours of classroom experience to become a firefighter. And you know what? I got it done. My time as a firefighter was so influential and taught me the importance of public service. Serving in the Colorado State Legislature has been one of the greatest honors of my life. It’s allowed me to lead on key issues as Chair of the Joint Technology Committee and Chair of the Legislative LGBTQ+ Caucus, while also contributing on committees focused on fiscal policy, budgeting, environment, and energy. What’s stayed with me the most, though, are the conversations I’ve had with Coloradans in every corner of our state. Hearing their stories, sharing in their hopes and frustrations, and learning about the issues they care about has been deeply grounding. The moments when someone tells me I’ve been the representation they needed to see – those are the reasons I keep showing up to do the work. Too often we see self-serving leaders who run for office for all the wrong reasons. I’m running because public service is in my bones, and my experience has prepared me to serve Colorado as State Treasurer. Let’s win this together. Brianna Fighting for working families, consumer protections, and small businesses in the House of Representatives has been the honor of Brianna's lifetime. ## RFK takes on the medical establishment...
In recent months, the MAHA movement has exploded, picking up wins left and right.
Led by RFK, the Department of Health and Human Services has been working to address chronic diseases, tackle Big Food and Big Pharma, fix American health care...and it's working.
You'd think after decades of the same health policy failures, Democrats would welcome a shake-up.
Nope.
At a lively Senate hearing yesterday, RFK laid into the broken system, but Democrats wouldn't budge.
They doubled down, defending the system that has failed millions of Americans.
I'll be honest, I'm all for sticking with tried and true methods.
You know, "if it ain't broke..."
But American health is in crisis - it is badly broken.
The status quo obviously isn't working; why is the Left so threatened by attempts to heal it?
Let's break it down...

Peter,

For decades, the science has been clear: Medication abortion is overwhelmingly safe and effective. But the Trump administration is trying to cloud that truth with secrecy and political interference.

[**Today, we filed a lawsuit against the Trump administration for failing to respond to our FOIA requests for information about HHS' and FDA's actions on medication abortion.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/114680145/567805744/1824768205?sourceid=1150877&utm_campaign=26emama-0903aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=foia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzY1N2IyMS03YzhhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UdVAezuVoeo3K7BrRUJLt3NZPj2ja4G-qxauh1YluVc=&emci=65193941-d989-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=5c657b21-7c8a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=954237) | [**FUND THE LAWSUIT**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/114680147/567805745/1824768205?sourceid=1150877&utm_campaign=26emama-0903aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=foia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzY1N2IyMS03YzhhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UdVAezuVoeo3K7BrRUJLt3NZPj2ja4G-qxauh1YluVc=&emci=65193941-d989-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=5c657b21-7c8a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=954237 "FUND THE LAWSUIT")
---
We asked for safety data and information about potential political influence in decision making about mifepristone, the abortion pill safely used by millions. _What did we get in return? Silence. Delays. Confusion._

The public has a right to know if political pressure is influencing decisions about mifepristone. But the administration is refusing to turn over the documents.

[**So we're escalating: we're taking them to court to force them to release the truth.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/114680148/567805747/1824768205?sourceid=1150877&utm_campaign=26emama-0903aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=foia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzY1N2IyMS03YzhhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UdVAezuVoeo3K7BrRUJLt3NZPj2ja4G-qxauh1YluVc=&emci=65193941-d989-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=5c657b21-7c8a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=954237)

Because this isn't just about paperwork. It's about exposing how anti-abortion forces are working behind closed doors to restrict medication abortion. What is the Trump administration hiding from us? We're using every legal tool possible to dig in and find out, but litigation takes resources. [**That's where you come in.**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/114680150/567805748/1824768205?sourceid=1150877&utm_campaign=26emama-0903aax-on&utm_medium=ea&utm_source=email&utm_content=foia&amtOpts=&recurringAmtOpts=&am=&recurringAm=&is_optimized_ask=true&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9DRlJSL0NGUlIvMS85NTk4MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YzY1N2IyMS03YzhhLWYwMTEtYjQ4NC02MDQ1YmRlYjc0MTMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UdVAezuVoeo3K7BrRUJLt3NZPj2ja4G-qxauh1YluVc=&emci=65193941-d989-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=5c657b21-7c8a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=954237)

name: Jim Marchant
subject: Take Back Our Schools
body:
Protect Nevada Children From Radical Agendas
| | | | | [](https://sb6nl6fbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015m6pz4OxESRq2PqP2V5ijEuEdGqwDTesHXSHJq2KZ7Sx5HOWZPUWNe5al7VUJKe8abVU0rZIUeZ-y5VnPkuivQ3PxpuFYD2X2uSuq0R0NSBaRA-OYCnYy-cx3y6zCCqhvlDBtiMRDK2zPu-oKKahhgmcfz7etnaL&c=SuuPy-pN3-j5u2k-klmxhJrzE6BoRW4fiQyIMCpu22_pUu3mL4HWuQ==&ch=LJXGke5XHEh9TH24c1SagZALbVmvMYmuk4wJQ8Ox7c50-oYmbLtp_g==)
---
| Peter,
---
Nevada families are tired of seeing Washington elites and left-wing activists try to take over our classrooms. Schools should teach reading, writing, and real-life skills, not radical gender ideology or political propaganda.
I am running for Congress to put parents back in charge and to make sure our schools reflect Nevada values, not the woke agenda of the far left. No child should be forced to declare pronouns or be exposed to sexual content in the name of education.
This is a fight for our children and for the future of our state. I will stand with President Trump and with every America First patriot to stop the radical left from destroying our values and our way of life. Together we can protect our kids, defend parental rights, and take back our schools.

subject: Re: 🚨 TAKE ACTION: Stop the Climate Chaos Plan! 🚨
body:
Hi Peter,
I’m reaching out about this again, because we’re coming up on the deadline to take action to stop these roll backs for our health, clean air, and environment! We have until September 22nd to put pressure on the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) to continue our protection from harmful pollution. Will you take a second to send your message now before it’s too late? [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2]
Take action now! [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2?contactdata=+oGjzDLpS2DbCDrGvJZF4xcN6m89m3F4t/MkE/wZD3fbcsR2oT8TGrjdu9allrEGac9yURUJ0DQupIRcrW5A1jwjg6M9omxRDz+UB1wrnSNa874LgWj3GDzaziPtD/k8]
If we let the Trump Administration move forward with these proposed detrimental steps back, our health and environment will pay the price later. We need to show the EPA that this is not in the public’s interest.
Thank you,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director
https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2?contactdata=+oGjzDLpS2DbCDrGvJZF4xcN6m89m3F4t/MkE/wZD3fbcsR2oT8TGrjdu9allrEGac9yURUJ0DQupIRcrW5A1jwjg6M9omxRDz+UB1wrnSNa874LgWj3GDzaziPtD/k8 [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2?contactdata=+oGjzDLpS2DbCDrGvJZF4xcN6m89m3F4t/MkE/wZD3fbcsR2oT8TGrjdu9allrEGac9yURUJ0DQupIRcrW5A1jwjg6M9omxRDz+UB1wrnSNa874LgWj3GDzaziPtD/k8]
Dear Peter,
The current administration is up to no good again, this time attacking our public health and pollution policies, and attempting to implement a climate denial plan that will roll back the Environmental Protection Agency’s (EPA) standards for vehicles, power plants, and other climate-harming pollution. Peter, [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2?contactdata=+oGjzDLpS2DbCDrGvJZF4xcN6m89m3F4t/MkE/wZD3fbcsR2oT8TGrjdu9allrEGac9yURUJ0DQupIRcrW5A1jwjg6M9omxRDz+UB1wrnSNa874LgWj3GDzaziPtD/k8] will you take a second to protect our health, environment, and economy? [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2]
Take action now! [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2?contactdata=+oGjzDLpS2DbCDrGvJZF4xcN6m89m3F4t/MkE/wZD3fbcsR2oT8TGrjdu9allrEGac9yURUJ0DQupIRcrW5A1jwjg6M9omxRDz+UB1wrnSNa874LgWj3GDzaziPtD/k8]
Donald Trump and EPA Administrator Lee Zeldin are putting forward a plan that claims climate change and the pollution that causes it pose no threat to public health or the environment. Zeldin and Trump’s Climate Chaos Plan makes climate denial official U.S. policy, and they intend to undo standards that limit pollution from cars and trucks, power plants and other sources of climate pollution. This Climate Chaos Plan is a cornerstone of Trump's Polluters' First Agenda that will do nothing to bring down costs or improve health for American families, and in fact will increase pollution that causes severe health conditions like asthma and lung cancer. It lets polluters get richer while we pay the price – with our health, our wallets, and our lives.
They will do this by eliminating the Endangerment Finding, which gives the EPA authority to regulate climate pollution. This move denies basic facts of climate change, and repeals carbon pollution and air quality protections that will increase Americans' energy costs, drive up prices on everyday goods and services, eliminate thousands of good-paying jobs, and result in tens of thousands of lost work days every year. Essentially, putting polluters and their profits over people.
Additionally, the EPA has proposed to roll back minimum federal standards for greenhouse gas emissions from motor vehicles [https://www.epa.gov/regulations-emissions-vehicles-and-engines/proposed-rule-reconsideration-2009-endangerment-finding] , increasing our risk for cancer and chronic disease, while damaging our environment and economy. Without these standards, American families will have to pay more for the next generation of cars, as they will be significantly more expensive to fuel, maintain, and repair. Not to mention, this would end the over 50 year practice of vehicle standards by the federal government.
Take action now! [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2?contactdata=+oGjzDLpS2DbCDrGvJZF4xcN6m89m3F4t/MkE/wZD3fbcsR2oT8TGrjdu9allrEGac9yURUJ0DQupIRcrW5A1jwjg6M9omxRDz+UB1wrnSNa874LgWj3GDzaziPtD/k8]
Please take action on this urgent matter now before the public hearings. [https://secure.everyaction.com/hEbNUE5J60izMdxOMcKbAQ2] It’s time to put the pressure on now before we pay the price with our health and environment later.
Sincerely,
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AVLCV/1/70877/images/Britney_signature-removebg-preview.png]
Britney VanCitters (she/her)
OLCV Political & Organizing Director

What I saw there will never leave me: not a city marked by war, but a city erased. Utter, complete, and total destruction. Block after block reduced to rubble. body:
https://maxinefororegon.com/ [https://maxinefororegon.com/]
Peter,
Every year, we brace for fire season. And every year, fires feel stronger, the season gets longer, and the outcomes are more destructive.
Yet, teachers and childcare providers are left to guess how to protect our children from wildfire smoke events because Congress hasn’t provided science-based policies from real experts and doctors , based on real evidence , to protect students exposed to wildfire smoke. And RFK Jr. is too busy spreading medical misinformation to step up to the plate and address the health implications of wildfires.
So, as a critical care and lung doctor, I’m changing that. I couldn’t sit back and watch.
I introduced the Shielding Students from Wildfire Smoke Act to help schools and childcare centers prepare before disaster strikes.
As a physician, I’ve treated the damage wildfire smoke leaves behind. I have seen children rushed in with asthma attacks. I have watched patients struggle to breathe as their conditions got worse. I have seen families terrified that the smoke will permanently damage their lungs.
I know how important it is to have timely and accessible medical care. So it’s been heartbreaking to watch the Trump administration gut Medicaid, risking the health care of more than 200,000 Oregonians and 17 million Americans.
My bill brings together the Environmental Protection Agency and the National Academies of Sciences, Engineering, and Medicine to review how schools and childcare providers respond to wildfire smoke and to give them the tools they need to keep kids safe.
Because every child deserves safe air. Every teacher and caregiver deserves the power to protect themselves and the kids who count on them. And every American deserves leadership that will put health and science first.
I am ready to keep fighting for this work, but I cannot do it alone. Will you stand with me and make a donation today so we can keep pushing the House to act—using real science , real evidence , and real solutions to protect our families? body:
[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1be29d8c5b4f45c9a38595e35e35899e&_e=fNCt-ww23MwJ-HiErhX_f2VcbLpt2MFhm2W2ltOgcEksoQBD55asUq-B_ArdLpRM1MtCeKedoO7R4PfXT68h04ScD7Sn9z5-CkiDqVu5hvLoeHYA5b_Qvc5_7ueWuaAEJAGrmuxp3sQ_kahVkb-QRclx2Zf-zDHR4jwLqc4JabMCnJBwvFM9jptBaVRO2PV_L3nNSH5dSBSwkukD9PKDBq09YRSpCzTki5XTq6a8ECPJtYj86ka2GG8yV51Ah8336iEQ87bMyADg9_Bu8kNHDGT8DjVU8RuU4oztEk53CLg3kOUdKCW17TzSjVmdgJLw_IOPOJj3czeQzvVQ5QI1yDI0XCUEEzB30YK0uuKLU1gp0csT_UmLFx6wQcGrc0sTPbYIMUjm8Trz56OqlAK3-EXF4sSEh3-AQ1cAARWjPnso2ybIeVY7dAWQzOSFxcOYTRnW_kWOmmmJM5yr4P4Toq9TF6zaNbXilrARgYC-qtntb2i1-EReUnVswZ_mxUEna9ub6y60a3wQNb9gD4bLLeGGSioYjQRZnJ2gN_3HB44n97Rj7PDaTpv4mSqKhTyDGkM56GiF2T3IogFhj-RUsLn72UVbVrRDK7W2pJlqoZ_pupE5SOYb8DhiWIw3cRSa)

Fellow Patriot,

Did you know the Star Spangled Banner was written by a political prisoner?

Francis Scott Key was under guard by the British (_he knew too much_) when the victory of the American patriots at the Battle of Baltimore inspired him to write the lyrics.

_There is a reason that we January 6th hostages sang it while locked in the D.C. gulag._

**You see, I was one of the patriots arrested for being at the Capitol on January 6th. What we suffered through is an experience I will never forget.**

It's what inspired me to create Stand in the Gap, a non-profit that helps January 6th hostages and others who've been affected by our justice system succeed in their second chance at freedom and end the two-tiered system of justice in this country.

Before I tell you more about my experience, I have to ask for your support so Stand in the Gap can provide help, hope, and healing to these American patriots in need.

[Please click below to help us restore the promise of the American Dream today.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1be29d8c5b4f45c9a38595e35e35899e&_e=fNCt-ww23MwJ-HiErhX_f2VcbLpt2MFhm2W2ltOgcEksoQBD55asUq-B_ArdLpRM1MtCeKedoO7R4PfXT68h04ScD7Sn9z5-CkiDqVu5hvLoeHYA5b_Qvc5_7ueWuaAEJAGrmuxp3sQ_kahVkb-QRclx2Zf-zDHR4jwLqc4JabOYVA_ggWCNCiK5YBCQ7fTB9j0tIuO-3EnZu-URJdj8f4E9GcI0En1-or3rH2pJZGXR0RbiDHJQvutpbTHzzCKIXa6h5CA3an7nZb3DnkZemz23-zut4kHCqDQJVed6zTICSTPO90na9D6qzDOuOnZJFxacu12Da1xA7rVJI8Ad6Au97OAe9c1kDtHyvStJ-abs6aA-rPVjZ_JyCvQq9wkdAuo_BtVQq9gBNAboqyorGSAed-EDeiXPlxPikI8ShzFSu_1cpNKMzqilExmJft5gnQLQJ8Y_S6JaB614R6PhDI9YkqZaiuaoT22YtiT992AzOrPxxjzR7vQeJGQST3Uj6AlD1IgJ7vOOp2DmIqJLAZbD8VjdQaTyiS7QVvYMGImBwUnbBhlIgCU0qdVB9qwCiLeV8yBqAND19ii1UuYyOlziR7Lockvv_Cw0iekO63emWCD8Svghcrt9XkQn5Xnh)

[Donate](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1be29d8c5b4f45c9a38595e35e35899e&_e=fNCt-ww23MwJ-HiErhX_f2VcbLpt2MFhm2W2ltOgcEksoQBD55asUq-B_ArdLpRM1MtCeKedoO7R4PfXT68h04ScD7Sn9z5-CkiDqVu5hvLoeHYA5b_Qvc5_7ueWuaAEJAGrmuxp3sQ_kahVkb-QRclx2Zf-zDHR4jwLqc4JabPPwD4kje8zWTc5XI-V4vgJ9--PIXtkFLvqe4rqHbxzp0i0dXXPBoQWnboL5zwvarNdt550qWHx8R3xTUV8pdgHOenx_Y_TjW2Up1dA2qZjSe22DFfAP0LDmwzvbkJm73sbrCV7_GY8ZXJBBaVcLerlj943rEHLgg8LsfugObuIGusjLI7UvNM1RfAyxWkKTwFn7CuMeFcuwbvFXBfsA0_RnYW4_Aao8KoAlS_KeeyvzdEbvcK1cBWAfvMNG7FA_7pZsIpvXB0ah7ucfMCZd6XyKnXzm9ekUnlziiefnNmqqqRlsJA5MgnD4GzgqlBWQ7fu4KJr6pG5fBR6APPvkDKdioT-_Gj2A4HYDosjoo8_1uzC6DlYVzIT5VHE915bfrHdxVPKOCFqQpJc9IM4OlRmtjkJsdEooJTPOhzx_OJqg5Q2IiJ_BXDtB0l_6pmu4yBJVEfsihh2LJX3hNWMWWnPaezw-eaNcy1M9MjtFUiRiQ%3D%3D)

_**" Oh, say can you see, by the dawn's early light"**_

I will never forget standing behind the bars of the DC jail on the Fourth of July, staring through a narrow window as fireworks burst over the Capitol.

It was a strange and surreal feeling to watch the glow of freedom while being caged by the very government that was supposed to defend it.

_**" What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming"**_

Even in that dark place, even while they tried to strip away our rights, the spirit of America never left us.

On the Fourth of July, something powerful happened.

Men who came from every background stood shoulder to shoulder, pressing against those tiny windows.

**For a few moments, we were not inmates. We were Americans.**

Watching the night sky blaze with red, white, and blue.

_**" Whose broad stripes and bright stars, through the perilous fight"**_

Like my fellow January 6th hostages, I was in the fight of my life.

But even behind bars, even as the government tried to silence me, that banner still flew. A symbol that tyranny might try to break the body, but it cannot crush the spirit.

_**" O'er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming"**_

We watched through concrete and steel as the fireworks filled the air. Proof that freedom still existed out there. That freedom still mattered.

It was a painful reminder that it had been taken from us, but also a promise that it could be reclaimed.

_**" And the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air,
Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there."**_

That night in DC, those fireworks were more than a celebration. They were proof.

Proof that no matter how hard they tried to crush us, the flag was still there. _We were still there_.

_**" O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave,
O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave"**_

Even though we are now free, thanks to the grace of God and the bravery of President Trump, the fight is not over.

I want my fellow January 6th hostages to know that Stand in the Gap is still here to help them and their families rebuild what was stolen. clean_body: Fellow Patriot, Did you know the Star Spangled Banner was written by a political prisoner? Francis Scott Key was under guard by the British (he knew too much) when the victory of the American patriots at the Battle of Baltimore inspired him to write the lyrics. There is a reason that we January 6th hostages sang it while locked in the D.C. gulag. You see, I was one of the patriots arrested for being at the Capitol on January 6th. What we suffered through is an experience I will never forget. It's what inspired me to create Stand in the Gap, a non-profit that helps January 6th hostages and others who've been affected by our justice system succeed in their second chance at freedom and end the two-tiered system of justice in this country. Before I tell you more about my experience, I have to ask for your support so Stand in the Gap can provide help, hope, and healing to these American patriots in need. " Oh, say can you see, by the dawn's early light" I will never forget standing behind the bars of the DC jail on the Fourth of July, staring through a narrow window as fireworks burst over the Capitol. It was a strange and surreal feeling to watch the glow of freedom while being caged by the very government that was supposed to defend it. " What so proudly we hailed at the twilight's last gleaming" Even in that dark place, even while they tried to strip away our rights, the spirit of America never left us. On the Fourth of July, something powerful happened. Men who came from every background stood shoulder to shoulder, pressing against those tiny windows. For a few moments, we were not inmates. We were Americans. Watching the night sky blaze with red, white, and blue. " Whose broad stripes and bright stars, through the perilous fight" Like my fellow January 6th hostages, I was in the fight of my life. But even behind bars, even as the government tried to silence me, that banner still flew. A symbol that tyranny might try to break the body, but it cannot crush the spirit. " O'er the ramparts we watched were so gallantly streaming" We watched through concrete and steel as the fireworks filled the air. Proof that freedom still existed out there. That freedom still mattered. It was a painful reminder that it had been taken from us, but also a promise that it could be reclaimed. " And the rockets' red glare, the bombs bursting in air, Gave proof through the night that our flag was still there." That night in DC, those fireworks were more than a celebration. They were proof. Proof that no matter how hard they tried to crush us, the flag was still there. We were still there. " O say does that star-spangled banner yet wave, O'er the land of the free and the home of the brave" Even though we are now free, thanks to the grace of God and the bravery of President Trump, the fight is not over. I want my fellow January 6th hostages to know that Stand in the Gap is still here to help them and their families rebuild what was stolen. From transitional housing to wellness programs, credit repair to employment help, we are proving that freedom is not just an idea. It is a reality worth fighting for. **" Sen. Brandon Creighton's switch from lawmaking to Texas Tech leader signals a new era for higher ed," **Texas Tribune's **Jessica Priest** \-- "As the clock wound down on the year's [second overtime legislative session](https://substack.com/redirect/d990c4c2-ce42-4446-9f33-03bd3e9bb34e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), Lt. Gov.**Dan Patrick** , the powerful leader of the Texas Senate, took a few minutes to say goodbye to his right-hand man, Sen.**Brandon Creighton** : The architect of a recent bevy of laws reshaping higher education in Texas -- from the ban on diversity, equity and inclusion programs to limits on protests and faculty's influence on campuses -- was stepping down to take a new job overseeing those very changes.

Texas Tech regents voted Thursday to name the Conroe Republican their [sole finalist for chancellor](https://substack.com/redirect/a3c27c07-5687-44d4-9bdc-73dbec563a50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), the university system's top job, betting that his political connections and influence at the Capitol will help secure funding, expand research opportunities and elevate the system's profile.
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $7/mo](https://substack.com/redirect/53821aa1-5b96-4e6c-a998-394438eddb0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Chancellors are at the helm of each university system's fleet of campuses, and Texas universities have increasingly turned to politicians to lead them, a shift that Patrick celebrated Wednesday. He pointed to the Texas A&M and University of Texas systems' new chancellors -- **Glenn Hegar** , the state's former state comptroller and a former state senator, and former state Rep. **John Zerwas** , respectively -- as models of the kind of political leadership he believes universities need.

"There's a whole new look at least in Texas of who [university leaders] think should lead universities, people with legislative experience, people who have been accountable to the people, people who have a record," Patrick said. "You don't just have to have nine letters behind your name and some education degree to run a university when it really takes more than just that."
[BECOME A PAID SUBSCRIBER: $70/yr](https://substack.com/redirect/53821aa1-5b96-4e6c-a998-394438eddb0e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Experts say regents have increasingly prioritized political savvy over academic leadership when picking university system leaders, a statewide and national shift they warn could make higher education less independent and give politicians greater influence over academics, research and campus life.

**Barrett Taylor** , a higher education governance expert at the University of North Texas, said Creighton's selection signals that Texas is entering a new phase in that transformation.

"Enacting laws was part of the agenda for reshaping public higher education in Texas, but it's not where it ends," he said. "There are going to be additional steps, and this is probably one of those steps."

**Ren ee Cross**, senior executive director at the University of Houston's Hobby School of Public Affairs, agreed.

"It just makes too much sense for public universities -- and for those in power -- to have, for lack of a better word, their 'lieutenants' in these high-ranking positions," she said. "If Lt. Gov. Patrick really wants to change the system of higher education in Texas -- and he's been pretty open about wanting to -- of course you'd want people you know and trust running these large university systems. I don't see that changing anytime soon. Even if Democrats controlled the state years from now, I could see them doing the same thing."

In an interview with The Texas Tribune, Texas Tech Board Chair **Cody Campbell** said regents believe the chancellor's job is fundamentally different from a campus president's, and should emphasize representation before state leaders rather than academic oversight.

"We do not need a chancellor who knows how to run the math department," he said." [Texas Tribune](https://substack.com/redirect/d6cb280c-6881-4108-b8ad-e15e7b309b25?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**" Houston man charged with murder in shooting of 11-year-old boy after door knocking prank," **via AP**** \-- "Police have charged a Houston man with murder in [the fatal shooting of an 11-year-old boy](https://substack.com/redirect/9d1ba8bf-f4f7-47a8-a8b0-fd211cfe4a7e?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) who knocked on the door of a home and ran away as a prank, police said Tuesday.

The 42-year-old man, identified by authorities as **Gonzalo Leon Jr**., was taken into custody and booked into the Harris County Jail in Houston early Tuesday. On local property records, Leon matches the name of the owner of the home where police say the boy knocked on the door.

Court records did not list an attorney for Leon to comment on the allegations.

The boy, **Julian Guzman** , and a cousin had been attending a birthday party Saturday night when they "became bored and wanted to ring doorbells, or play 'ding dong ditch,'" according to a probable cause affidavit. The prank commonly called "ding dong ditching" involves ringing a doorbell or knocking on a door and fleeing before someone inside opens the door.

Police departments around the country have issued public service announcements in recent months warning people that such actions aren't funny but dangerous. Homeowners have no way of knowing it's "just a prank," according to a June [Facebook post](https://substack.com/redirect/e9b8860c-f019-47e6-b4fa-835b5381bb98?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by the Georgetown, Kentucky Police Department.

Guzman's cousin told investigators he and Guzman knocked several times on Leon's door and ran away. In an initial statement, police had said Guzman rang a doorbell, but the affidavit said the boy knocked.

The final time he and the cousin knocked, Leon came out holding a pistol that he fired once into the ground. Leon then raised the pistol and fired at Guzman and his cousin, according to the affidavit.

"Our witness says the suspect came out of the door, ran out into the street and was firing down the road," Houston police Sgt. **Michael Cass** told reporters on Sunday.

Guzman's cousin told police that Guzman "cried out in pain that he had been shot," according to the affidavit. As Guzman's cousin was trying to drag the boy away, Leon slowly walked back to his house.

Guzman was shot in the back and died Sunday, police said.

"In my opinion, it doesn't look like any type of self-defense. It wasn't close to the house," Cass said.

Police found about 20 firearms in Leon's home, including AR-style rifles, shotguns and medium caliber pistols.

Texas and other states have some version of a "castle doctrine," either by law or court precedent, that says residents don't have to retreat when threatened in their homes but instead can respond with physical force. While Texas law gives people broad latitude to protect themselves, protect others or protect their property, there has to be a reasonable belief that force is immediately necessary in the situation.

**Seth Kretzer** , an attorney in Houston not connected to the case, said if the shooting happened as police allege then Leon would not have a strong case for self-defense under state law.

"You just can't shoot a kid in the street dead because he knocks on your doorbell and declare you felt threatened by him. I mean it's a little hard to believe a grown male with a gun felt threatened by an unarmed 11-year-old child running away on the street," Kretzer said." [AP](https://substack.com/redirect/cbe01edc-2846-467f-b01c-f4d9a65e555c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

**Alex Fairly guest column: "GOP purity tests are self-destructive," **AP's **Sean Murphy** \-- "Texas Republicans are enjoying what we in the business world refer to as Run Rate Acceleration. The 2025 Legislative session, while not perfect, was one of the most conservative in Texas history. Our governor, lieutenant governor and speaker of the House are working effectively together, as well as with their respective caucuses, to advance conservative legislation. And Speaker **Dustin Burrows** recently received the total endorsement of President **Donald Trump**. There is more to do, but Texas is unquestionably the nation's conservative beacon.

But certain factions within our party are working to undermine, attack and politically cancel some conservative legislators simply because they don't align 100% with the definition of conservative held by a narrow faction of the party. In business-speak, we call that counterproductive.

At a recent meeting of the State Republican Executive Committee, this faction pushed an overzealous effort to conduct a "performance review" that would have formally undermined a majority of Texas House Republicans via Rule 44 of the party's regulations. That effort ended with a more measured review being adopted. But members did adjourn the meeting by encouraging Republican precinct members across Texas to look for broader opportunities to censure candidates.

Censure is an important tool in party governance. But when it is overused, weaponized or used as a misguided purity test, it will weaken our movement, diminish our credibility and risk undoing what we have fought to build. That is why [I was willing to fund litigation](https://substack.com/redirect/b434f8a3-26b3-4007-bfac-4a8543fd5745?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) opposing this measure. While we must uphold the principles we believe in, history shows that attempts to purify a movement almost always end in disaster, division and decline.

The counterexample is President Trump. He has dramatically expanded the Republican Party, bringing in millions of voters who only a few years ago would have never considered voting Republican. A recent[ analysis of voter registration data](https://substack.com/redirect/0ad55f4f-c0e5-483a-828a-3ed0068cea61?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) by _The New York Times_ found that since 2020, Democrats have lost more than 2.1 million voters across 30 states and the District of Columbia, while Republicans have gained 2.4 million. Trump even appointed two former Democrat presidential candidates to his Cabinet.

Texas Republicans should passionately debate our differences, policies and priorities. We should each zealously support candidates who best reflect our version of conservatism. But we must not fall into the trap of insisting all Republicans fit into the single, narrow mold of a specific faction of our party. We must recognize that a conservative representing suburban Dallas may not look, sound or vote exactly like a conservative representative from Midland or Amarillo.

If we attempt to force all members into a certain mold, we will lose Republican seats and weaken our party. While we can never abandon our conservative principles for the sake of growth, our strength comes not from extreme conformity, but from the universal appeal of those principles and their ability to improve the lives of Texans.

A year ago I was in a camp that believed we must fight to rid ourselves of Republicans who aren't as conservative as I am. Today, I am no less conservative, but I have come to see the reality that things like Rule 44 and the recent fixation on censure are symptoms of a deeper illness in Texas conservative politics: the eagerness to attack and destroy Republicans who aren't exactly like us.

Republicans are in the middle of a historic surge. Voters are running toward our tent. This is a time for growth, strength and unity -- not division, confusion or infighting.

Imagine how much more effective we could be if we stopped fighting with one another and focused all our energy on fighting for every Texan.

_Alex Fairly is an Amarillo businessman and founder of the Texas Republican Leadership Fund PAC."_[DMN](https://substack.com/redirect/fec616a5-d769-4567-a565-5734a97fe83d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)

**" Company behind East Texas water grab hired key lobbyists just before bill delaying it died," **Houston Chronicle's **Megan Kimble** \-- "The Texas Senate voted against delaying a [controversial East Texas groundwater export project](https://substack.com/redirect/78958659-3120-4d5c-94d0-56fff52a371a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) on the same day the company behind it hired one of Lt. Gov. **Dan Patrick's** top advisors as a lobbyist.

Conservation Equity Management, a company affiliated with Dallas investor **Kyle Bass** , hired**Allen Blakemore** on Tuesday, the same day the legislation hit the Senate floor, according to [lobbying records filed at the Texas Ethics Commission](https://substack.com/redirect/5fdb9ed1-7972-4e5e-857d-97218a9961eb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). Blakemore is [Patrick's political consultant](https://substack.com/redirect/b9ca941d-8602-4bb4-9d00-a9b88f32bf7f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and has also worked on the campaigns of several Republican senators.

The Senate, which Patrick oversees, ultimately agreed to back a state-led study of the company's proposal to pump huge amounts of groundwater out from under Anderson and Henderson counties. But it stripped a provision that would have put the project on hold until the findings came out in 2027.

The change "gutted the most important part of this bill," according to the author, state Rep. **Cody Harris** , whose district includes the counties Bass is looking to tap. The legislation [ultimately died on Wednesday night when the special session ended](https://substack.com/redirect/4fe0e378-6c50-4cdb-874a-e7bea39efb8f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), in a win for Bass.

Blakemore directed questions to Bass, whose spokesperson did not respond to a request for comment. Patrick said in a statement that he was "not involved in it at any level."

He said the senator who sponsored the bill and the one who chaired the committee that vetted it made all the decisions.

"I told them we would do whatever they decided - it was up to them," Patrick said.

Two companies affiliated with Bass have applied for exploratory permits for wells capable of pumping more groundwater out from under the two counties than is currently available.

The companies have not yet applied for permits to export the water, but Bass signaled that is his intention, saying that the water was needed to address looming shortages elsewhere and could go "anywhere south of Waco and... north of Dallas-Fort Worth." The permit decision now rests with the State Office of Administrative Hearings.

Harris, a Republican from Palestine, [filed House Bill 27 in response to local backlash](https://substack.com/redirect/f3c52fed-1314-43ff-a96a-635a6963aa9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The bill would have required the Texas Water Development Board to study the effects of groundwater pumping in the aquifers below Anderson and Henderson counties and present it to state leaders. In the meantime, the groundwater conservation district would not be able to issue a new production or export permit for the region.

Water experts have said that diverting water from the area's Carrizo-Wilcox Aquifer could impact downstream users of surface water - like the City of Houston - because the aquifer helps replenish rivers and streams.

Shortly after HB 27 was filed, [Bass lashed out at Harris](https://substack.com/redirect/f3c52fed-1314-43ff-a96a-635a6963aa9b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) and threatened to sue him in a since-deleted post on X. "Small time Texas politician convincing the Governor... to allow an East Texas groundwater permit application to be delayed two years creates an immediate Federal Takings case," he wrote in August. "See you in Federal Court @CodyHarrisTX."

While the legislation easily cleared the House, state Sen. **Robert Nichols** , a Republican from Jacksonville and the bill's sponsor in the Senate, said the moratorium was removed because it was the only way to get the legislation out of committee and through the upper chamber.

During a committee hearing on Tuesday, several Republicans pushed back against the proposed moratorium, saying it set a dangerous precedent.

"At this point, how do we say that we're going to put a moratorium in just those two counties or that groundwater district and not everywhere else in the state?" said state Sen. **Paul Bettencourt** , a Houston Republican.

Records show Blakemore is one of several lobbyists Bass' company brought on in the waning days of the special session.

Two employees of Blakemore Public Affairs are also listed as lobbyists for the company: **Avery Dishaw** , a former staffer for Bettencourt, and Casey Haney. **David Whitley** , the former Secretary of State and deputy chief of staff to Gov. **Greg Abbott** , also lists Conservation Equity Management as a client, as of August 27.

According to the ethics commission records, Blakemore would be paid between $56,000 and $111,000 for work between September 2 and December 31, 2025." [Hou Chron](https://substack.com/redirect/3819d9ff-447a-45ff-8281-df5c9c1ee977?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg) ($)
