| | _**Fighting for Ratepayers, Protecting Taxpayers**_
---
Friends, This week, Governor Mike Braun is taking on the rising utility costs that hit Hoosier families hardest. He’s putting consumers first, pushing back on repeated rate hikes, and making clear that it’s time for utilities’ investors to carry more of the load—not hardworking families. At the same time, Indiana earned another big win on the financial front. Our state once again secured a AAA credit rating, placing us among the very best in the nation. That means lower costs for taxpayers, a stronger economy, and proof that discplined conservative leadership is delivering results. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with.
---
| |
---
| | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman
---
|
---
| | |
---
---
| | _**Governor Braun Takes Action to Protect Hoosier Ratepayers**_
---
---
Governor Mike Braun announced Abby Gray as Indiana’s new Utility Consumer Counselor and directed the office to review utility company profits and identify cost-saving measures to reduce the burden on ratepayers. Citing repeated rate hikes, Governor Braun said utilities’ investors should bear more of the costs of doing business rather than Hoosier families. Gray, a longtime public servant, said she is honored to continue advocating for consumers in her new role. "Hoosiers have been burdened with utility rate increase after increase. We can’t take it anymore. I am directing the Utility Consumer Counselor, who is Indiana’s ratepayer advocate, to evaluate utilities’ profits along with other cost savings measures to ease the burden on ratepayers. I would also like to see the utilities' investors bear more of the cost of doing business." \- Governor Braun via a [press release](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/U8DwvwCEzrFJTBglvuZjU2sQWepJEiYrBHKoEMv9oHbI7W_fH2zKJO15J0dSPcAoSwaiAAnaghSELO0k_Iaw6KM-3ZYHGHOfAfCl7dTLet4XeytCHrgCteOCPULlohFEOX9d1x5cp2iVpECXk31Li3dF9-0b5q-of4ECTcGYHelsr0OFqwN-x0AjoGTjkznmMRjaEYmQrTZ_cnD0cp3UNOT88jvyHWMHyOE2PY9RlAu_bKjOGaXRzEeyFalj_K2G7o9ddGBSNIn7yTCGsTiBpOn7b5dX8_j6ByHXUP7XbKg002-VVYNN2WoZg48slSGfzbipw9336HMTWP6vDknbp4UyAh-UAWG8HRmHEvD1k9NOvuadJaH3TwIWheFBQWCPrfSrZtzZC5OHvmykbC-Sz6ZFrbVGafVn_tSDV9EbI9djoLI-NbpM_qypBw4lbZytU574-qBaszVQkvs-n0h_gEINKzAywAjUKQHAU8tzIRZmiQggzGv0weT027PloDZ2iYMgXapYdiPP5-ur5RpJWJAqBYni4aaLbxfgXUlDUzzEClIzFqE3a4JP9Qpzvdxx8db8-AoL3EW1EfQMKAKPWTTVUUQLGrbboEu8QRU1DQ2vNF8sE46Tz1NNQ6u_8BX0lYIEm63_A4fXQNW8M9xpDNat1js6L8f1Fqljkx49cHqibOtRy3Zq5YIuh7zfv8-p1hTBOy1iUNnmOB4zarwjl5XkN8XXS95zADhnrbX7evFdpPTdMaEQoJHFxyRughxZxA/fZduDHAyd_grQvvRAU5UqbigzgASwJtk/12)

_**Indiana Earns AAA Credit Rating 15 Years in a Row**_
---
---
Governor Braun announced that Indiana has maintained a AAA credit rating from all three major agencies, S&P, Moody’s, and Fitch, placing the state among only 14 nationwide with the highest possible rating. The achievement saves taxpayer dollars through lower borrowing costs while supporting investments in infrastructure, education, and public services. Governor Braun emphasized that Indiana’s strong financial position ensures resilience during downturns and keeps the state competitive in attracting jobs and growth. "Indiana’s AAA rating is more than a financial milestone; It’s a signal to taxpayers, investors, and businesses that our state is well-managed, fiscally responsible, and focused on delivering growth for Hoosiers throughout the State.” \- Governor Braun via a [press release](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/RVLAw15-aactK5oiejtyHalNuByRPIjmwzbn5jGbs1xHWs-CAc8Z20gUQ1Hq2i8SzVOkqsYc21cw3R3ZHKG6Z6wzjn8E-xiKRkpMGN50m8wGEpTtJXZiOm46_txhIX5YFdw9214-3Ekph4_HDYnbBse5gLSZ0Y98CTx1S6MxpcprDXMsFKGxVXyyJ_-dl7MHrn_VGDxXnjms8JAEFtx7nyVYTqG6_6eLZ-v0cwvQclwyYYfmMIYljvN73rrm0wFtJR4tpRg3z9l55CZtH9CytMKR_4OR5M3_IJz7_HLBwHcl8Gay82QhGhgsJLKVrIc9G5MOwlAp9_iny4BrzmW4hmnwEaoQ1qM9SzpJeiHm1iUkqByUg5xM-xnAVrga4_RYL31qaHjLFlaI2h573f2_MV67RUMvRi2Ljl7QzXILIRzoN3V3Lwzw7kc-UEkqGELR_wbT5rwEaDH7YzZUrU5TX0I02PVtRjmXgTiZFFPuUjOlHd8g7uYbvod-kpf-8bJGzSxBY1jN56f749K1J7nBCectN3JfoV-uWUxtmsO1O_0xWd5wgPdW3ikxwbNfv1Hz3TXvmmcJgVvLMcq__p9k_zU8hogQym0Xxm4qF0hJpGMf0rvGYT-A/bbjBIqDspl2plcM8hTyVwdYcZGfIZuMi/12)[](http://links.email.in-gop.com/s/c/KmnBqlvr_jg6cM10zCvei_DdKUL3RXwMQ9FFdgNXZQcaPTyh9KJsKlosAzOehA_OYqUvI_0KuvIZ48QutLF7xObKIJlsYh3gi4jHB8-De9KL7G0Sbq6CB0yTGQZ8Zu-nUW58J3V-pYeglY2M2drsne_F-aWRlwJLt0NLvzl1vyhlUqoPd7cdKPbDPKd0WmSL7_Xg3umXQxIDlASKMiU2e9AHfu1OGcfpvxviPBlxsOcZVF43cAWLau0uTshgDK3Tm6OQnWyEuVbJ476swJm1Dds3VEPwd0McjNERp81amzf6vRsmTSaAMwDESXAP-1jeziud3XW-H3YB4Jz29kwAWT-ULTQQpnw8fJXvFqBZ3CvhfyGUv0fZy-i76BwhGAX3D9fVejdITbVgoD47Ig6i5twYGOMQhoI3PuNIa7EUvBPVg1LQXJOiLqmbFrtjaNMaj3Nj2mXo4OFuih5PLuJVZjdnH4B770mL5lK1-u4Mm9io6QSQufxyy_zCAUbc7jusNh7lPPzuJOktbGnfe0d5RDcp3-MjSuWdso_MxSMoW3JMF3P2uG9Q8P91cOxdTTxLHHJ8jq7UelB1-Qo2z6sBwalgolivGuE/zR8poB1N23_9i9ORxevrGZnIE6UPBJT6/12)

clean_body: | | | | | | | Fighting for Ratepayers, Protecting Taxpayers Friends, This week, Governor Mike Braun is taking on the rising utility costs that hit Hoosier families hardest. He’s putting consumers first, pushing back on repeated rate hikes, and making clear that it’s time for utilities’ investors to carry more of the load—not hardworking families. At the same time, Indiana earned another big win on the financial front. Our state once again secured a AAA credit rating, placing us among the very best in the nation. That means lower costs for taxpayers, a stronger economy, and proof that discplined conservative leadership is delivering results. As always, thank you for being a part of our team. Please feel free to reach out if there's anything I can assist with. | | | | Lana Keesling, Indiana GOP Chairwoman | | | | | | Governor Braun Takes Action to Protect Hoosier Ratepayers Governor Mike Braun announced Abby Gray as Indiana’s new Utility Consumer Counselor and directed the office to review utility company profits and identify cost-saving measures to reduce the burden on ratepayers. Citing repeated rate hikes, Governor Braun said utilities’ investors should bear more of the costs of doing business rather than Hoosier families. Gray, a longtime public servant, said she is honored to continue advocating for consumers in her new role. "Hoosiers have been burdened with utility rate increase after increase. We can’t take it anymore. I am directing the Utility Consumer Counselor, who is Indiana’s ratepayer advocate, to evaluate utilities’ profits along with other cost savings measures to ease the burden on ratepayers. I would also like to see the utilities' investors bear more of the cost of doing business." \- Governor Braun via a Indiana Earns AAA Credit Rating 15 Years in a Row Governor Braun announced that Indiana has maintained a AAA credit rating from all three major agencies, S&P, Moody’s, and Fitch, placing the state among only 14 nationwide with the highest possible rating. # AG Jeanine Pirro charges 2 teens with murder for fatal shooting of congressional intern
## _" Accountability" not "coddling"_
[](https://substack.com/redirect/0e72536b-0a31-4898-858b-ac1331bc6a42?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
DC US Attorney Jeanine Pirro announced that two 17-year-olds, Jalen Lucas and Kelvin Thomas Jr., **[have been charged with first-degree murder](https://substack.com/redirect/6a771253-010b-40b2-9784-a3031a2917f8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as adults for killing congressional intern Eric Tarpinian-Jachym, 21, in a July 1 shootout that unleashed 79 rounds near the White House.
"Eric didn't deserve to be gunned down, and the system failed hi," Pirro said. "The system that felt that juveniles needed to be coddled. And it's bad not to be gunned down on any street, but to be gunned down in our nation's capital is an outrage."
She added, "The DC Council thinks that these kids need to be protected. They don't need to be protected. They need to be made accountable, and we need to be protected... This killing underscores why we need the authority to prosecute these younger kids, because they're not kids, they're criminals."
* **Mistaken Target:** The three gunmen allegedly targeted a rival "neighborhood crew" member on a bike but struck Tarpinian-Jachym and other bystanders instead, with the intern working for Rep. Ron Estes (R-Kan.) becoming an unintended victim of the gang violence.
* **Juvenile Justice Reform Push:** Pirro criticized DC's juvenile justice system, arguing that the suspects "need to be made accountable" rather than "coddled," and called for Congress to restore federal prosecution authority over minors aged 14-17, which was previously transferred to the local DC attorney general.

As the nation's top health official, his conspiracy theory-driven, Trump-aligned agenda poses a clear and present danger to the health of the American people. And by:

Hi Team, What Trump is doing with the National Guard in Washington, D.C. is not about fighting crime or keeping people safe. And it isn’t just about intimidation, it's also a rehearsal. Every checkpoint, every armored vehicle, every overwhelming show of force is training for how to control and subdue America’s cities.

Trump tested it in Los Angeles. He escalated it in D.C. And now, more cities are in his crosshairs. This cannot become our new normal. We need Congress to step in and stop Trump's reckless, authoritarian deployment of the National Guard into our communities. **[Will you take a few minutes to send a letter to your representatives demanding they do everything in their power to rein in this strongman campaign before it’s too late?](https://click.everyaction.com/k/114693607/567848971/2006057854?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jane-bax-email-national-guard-ja&refcode=ea.edfd15af-a38a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ms=ea.edfd15af-a38a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVkZmQxNWFmLWEzOGEtZjAxMS1iNDg0LTYwNDViZGViNzQxMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KF38lXk6qKoTut6-2bAFm4FUL9vl-8SjDExxwOFD8_Q=&emci=a2fbaaba-9f8a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=edfd15af-a38a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=4823105)** | [**Start Writing**](https://click.everyaction.com/k/114693611/567848975/2006057854?source=direct_link&referrer=group-jfcp-woa&redirect=https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jane-bax-email-national-guard-ja&refcode=ea.edfd15af-a38a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ms=ea.edfd15af-a38a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImVkZmQxNWFmLWEzOGEtZjAxMS1iNDg0LTYwNDViZGViNzQxMyIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=KF38lXk6qKoTut6-2bAFm4FUL9vl-8SjDExxwOFD8_Q=&emci=a2fbaaba-9f8a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&emdi=edfd15af-a38a-f011-b484-6045bdeb7413&ceid=4823105)

U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R–Ala.) has been named Crime Stopper of the Year by Crime Stoppers of Metro Alabama, in recognition of her steadfast commitment to public safety, law enforcement support, and decisive legislative action.

The award was presented at the organization’s annual Crime Stopper of the Year Luncheon on Thursday, August 14, 2025, at The Finley Center in Hoover, Alabama. Hoover Mayor Frank Brocato introduced Senator Britt during the ceremony, which spotlighted individuals who have demonstrated extraordinary leadership in the fight against crime and embodied Crime Stoppers’ mission of creating safer communities.

U.S. Senator Katie Britt, R-Alabama, on Wednesday chaired a Senate Judiciary Committee hearing to consider several of President Donald Trump’s nominees for federal judgeships, including three selections from Alabama. The committee will vote on whether to advance the nominations for consideration by the full Senate.

The nominees under review were Edmund LaCour to serve on the Northern District of Alabama, Justice Bill Lewis for the Middle District of Alabama, and Hal Mooty for the Northern District of Alabama. Britt and Senator Tommy Tuberville, R-Alabama, had jointly recommended the nominees to Trump earlier this year.

clean_body: | | | | | | | Fresh off the heels of a major win for the State of Alabama with the announcement that the Trump Administration will permanently return Space Command headquarters to its original home in Huntsville, U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R-Montgomery) took a victory lap in praise of Alabama. “What this means for the community, what this means for small business, and what this means for Huntsville, this process has shown us the worst of Washington, D.C., Dale, and I believe that Huntsville is going to show America the very best of our country,” Britt said of the move. | | U.S. Senator Katie Britt (R–Ala.) has been named Crime Stopper of the Year by Crime Stoppers of Metro Alabama, in recognition of her steadfast commitment to public safety, law enforcement support, and decisive legislative action. The award was presented at the organization’s annual Crime Stopper of the Year Luncheon on Thursday, August 14, 2025, at The Finley Center in Hoover, Alabama. Hoover Mayor Frank Brocato introduced Senator Britt during the ceremony, which spotlighted individuals who have demonstrated extraordinary leadership in the fight against crime and embodied Crime Stoppers’ mission of creating safer communities. | | U.S. Senator Katie Britt, R-Alabama, on Wednesday chaired a Senate Judiciary Committee hearing to consider several of President Donald Trump’s nominees for federal judgeships, including three selections from Alabama. The committee will vote on whether to advance the nominations for consideration by the full Senate. The nominees under review were Edmund LaCour to serve on the Northern District of Alabama, Justice Bill Lewis for the Middle District of Alabama, and Hal Mooty for the Northern District of Alabama. Peter,

America was built on the promise that those who work hard for a living have a right to live with financial security and safety.

But right now, middle-class Americans are getting squeezed, earning too much to qualify for government assistance but not enough to keep up with our country’s rising cost of living. Working people feel they are forgotten about by both parties in power, worrying they won’t be able to provide for their children or retire comfortably.

Please read the following message from our sponsor.

Friend, Despite what decades of “green” propaganda and rhetoric have tried to convince us, there is no climate change emergency.But faulty science didn’t stop President Obama’s Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) from imposing a radical anti-fossil fuel agenda, including policies that limit Carbon Dioxide (CO2) emissions from power plants, automobiles, and trucks.But, CO2 is NOT a pollutant.Carbon Dioxide is BENEFICIAL — and necessary — for our environment. Carbon Dioxide is the basis of life on Earth.Americans have been fed Climate Fiction for years, and are now learning that coal, oil, natural gas, and nuclear power are far more affordable, efficient, and reliable than “green” energy.To help CO2 Coalition support an energy agenda promoting reliable, abundant and affordable energy, we need your gift of $25, $50, $100, or more today. Help STOP the “green” agendaFor years, hare-brained schemes — such as the Green New Deal and the Paris Climate Agreement — have sought to limit CO2 emissions, making it harder to get rid of real pollutants, impacting the ability of farmers to grow crops, and harming Americans and our environment. Limits on CO2 emissions have forced compliance with wind and solar energy — which are expensive, inefficient, unreliable, and not possible in some areas.For decades, fossil fuels — coal, oil, and natural gas — alongside nuclear power, have met global energy needs with unmatched efficiency. Unlike wind or solar, coal and nuclear plants can churn out electricity continuously month after month, rain or shine, and they can do so for a fraction of the cost that wind turbines and solar panels take to produce.A new American energy agenda is working to roll back the dangerous “green” energy policies that have been mere virtue signaling — not long-term solutions to improve our environment and our world. Your gift of $25 or more today will help us to spread the truth about CO2 emissions and how Americans have been misled for decades by junk science. Help STOP the “green” agendaOur commonsense energy agenda seeks to make America affordable and energy dominant again.At CO2 Coalition, we’ve been named a “key player” when it comes to exposing the truth about Carbon Dioxide and supporting the administration’s energy agenda. We are a nonprofit coalition of scientists and researchers from around the world who are devoted to educating the public and policymakers about the TRUTH — Carbon Dioxide is not a pollutant — it is hugely beneficial to ecosystems, agriculture and to humanity.Overturning years of disastrous “green” energy policies is a matter of sound science, not a political agenda. The federal government has poured millions of dollars into climate-focused programs that haven’t positively impacted the climate. We must support a new, common sense energy agenda while there’s a chance to reverse the damage. Please help with your immediate gift of $25, $50, $100, $250, $500, or more to help us expose the truth about CO2 to Americans and embrace energy sources that are abundant, affordable, and attuned to the world. When Americans know the truth about CO2 — not the lies perpetuated by “green” energy enthusiasts — they realize how important it is that we reverse environmental policies.But there is a lot of work to be done. We’re up against groups including The Environmental Defense Fund — who claim that our “health and safety” is at stake if the proposed common sense energy agenda becomes law — and the Center for Biological Diversity — who claim the Trump administration is exercising “malice toward the planet.” Your gift of $25 or more today will help us to STOP the radical “green” energy enthusiasts and reverse their failed energy policies. Help STOP the “green” agendaThank you for your support!Gregory Wrightstone Executive Director CO2 Coalition Support the CO2 Coalition2677 Prosperity Avenue, Suite 300Fairfax, VA 22031

# [Voting is now open](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=db4abd3828&e=b749ec4ed8) for the National Toddler of the Year!

[|

| | Who will win the National title of Toddler of the Year and star in a national toy ad? **You** get to decide! The quarterfinals are happening **now**. You can [**vote for FREE**](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=94c859dd94&e=b749ec4ed8) once every day. [Click here now to cast your vote!](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=5295123da0&e=b749ec4ed8)[ ](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=fbadc6928c&e=b749ec4ed8)
The **Quarterfinals end on Thursday September 11th** so make sure to [cast your **FREE vote**](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=f87a59bc61&e=b749ec4ed8) every single day from now until then. You can even click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=dcacbd9f3b&e=b749ec4ed8) to add a [daily reminder](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=9d9761230e&e=b749ec4ed8) to your calendar as an easy reminder to [vote](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=46d85a6027&e=b749ec4ed8).
And if you want to cast extra votes, every [**$1 you donate = 1 extra vote**](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=53cde1f1c6&e=b749ec4ed8) with **all proceeds supporting Toys for Tots**. Which means **your**[**donation**](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=d1a3882c91&e=b749ec4ed8)**is tax-deductible** , helps decide which kid wins the crown, AND supports toys going to kids in need this holiday season in cooperation with the US Marines. [](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=5c3fd503cf&e=b749ec4ed8)
ONLY the toddler who is ranked in 1st place on Thursday Sept. 11th will advance to the SemiFinals & can then move on to the Finals. Which means we have just two rounds left to decide who will be crowned Toddler of the Year. So make sure to [vote for Sophia](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=0291badc5c&e=b749ec4ed8) every day from now until next Thursday. You can [cast one FREE vote every 24 hours](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=4278b7b729&e=b749ec4ed8), or make a tax deductible donation with every $1 donated = 1 extra vote all for the benefit of Toy for Tots.
To [donate $10](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=089ce68663&e=b749ec4ed8) click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=e37fe0f067&e=b749ec4ed8). To [donate $25](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=1dce401be7&e=b749ec4ed8) click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=69d91dc96a&e=b749ec4ed8).To [donate $50](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=08a0f0f338&e=b749ec4ed8) click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=161062e918&e=b749ec4ed8).To [donate $100](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=d9dd44aa01&e=b749ec4ed8) click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=abde7d762c&e=b749ec4ed8). To [donate $250](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=58f67a5c14&e=b749ec4ed8) click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=c53dd2228f&e=b749ec4ed8).**ALL donations are TAX DEDUCTIBLE** & go to benefit Toys for Tots.
To cast a [FREE vote](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=47c270d7c6&e=b749ec4ed8) click [here](https://toddleroftheyear.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b753463ba6b7f88fcc279ec77&id=bb7842404f&e=b749ec4ed8).

subject: My recovery after the car crash
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Rudy Giuliani Freedom Fund Legal Defense Trust
body:
Because you’ve been a loyal supporter, I wanted you to hear this
directly from me.

[https://secure.winred.com/rudy-giuliani-freedom-fund-79a3adfa/e27e48aeac350dcc/?utm_campaign=20250904&utm_medium=email&utm_source=RW_B&utm_content=MAWCO&utm_term=lrm-active]

Friend,

So many kind souls like you have asked how I’m doing, so I wanted to
personally update you on my recovery.

I was hospitalized after a devastating car crash. We were struck by a
vehicle going what felt like 70-80 miles per hour. Had I not been
wearing a seatbelt, I would’ve been killed.

Right now, a back brace is holding my fractured spine together.

But if I could survive being arrested in the most violent jail in
America, I know I can survive _ANYTHING!_

[https://secure.winred.com/rudy-giuliani-freedom-fund-79a3adfa/e27e48aeac350dcc/?utm_campaign=20250904&utm_medium=email&utm_source=RW_B&utm_content=MAWCO&utm_term=lrm-active]
__

One thing especially helped take the pain away...

...PRESIDENT TRUMP HAS ANNOUNCED THAT HE WILL AWARD ME WITH THE
PRESIDENTIAL MEDAL OF FREEDOM – _THE HIGHEST CIVILIAN HONOR IN
AMERICA._

PRESIDENT TRUMP KNOWS I’M IN A DIRE SITUATION RIGHT NOW. HIS PARDON
POWERS ONLY APPLY TO _FEDERAL_ CASES, WHICH MEANS HE LEGALLY CANNOT
SAVE ME FROM THE BOGUS _STATE-LEVEL_ CHARGES BROUGHT AGAINST ME BY A
RADICAL DEMOCRAT ATTORNEY GENERAL WHO IS TRYING TO IMPRISON ME FOR 20
YEARS.

LEFT WITH NO PARDON, NO SAFETY NET, AND NO LIFELINE, MY ONLY CHANCE AT
WALKING FREE IS TO SECURE A TOP-NOTCH DEFENSE TEAM.

But the reality is, the Left had already forced me to the point of
BANKRUPTCY.

AND NOW, THIS CAR CRASH HAS SET ME BACK EVEN MORE...

And so, my last remaining hope of assembling the quality of defense
required to BEAT the Left’s sham charges and WIN the trial of my
life is patriots like YOU.

That’s why I’m making a final plea to humbly ask that you
contribute whatever amount you can to my Legal Defense Trust as I
continue fighting for my _FREEDOM_ and my _JUSTICE_.

_Because when President Trump places the Medal of Freedom around my
neck, I want history to always remember that I FOUGHT for my freedom
and justice until the VERY END!_

SO, IF YOU CAN, PLEASE MAKE A CONTRIBUTION TO THE RUDY GIULIANI
FREEDOM FUND TO ENSURE I HAVE THE RESOURCES NEEDED TO RETAIN A
TOP-NOTCH DEFENSE TEAM IN WHAT IS NOW THE FINAL BATTLE FOR MY FREEDOM
AND JUSTICE.

| | **_Meet Russell:_** Born and raised in Surfside Beach, SC, Congressman Russell Fry is the proud and homegrown Representative for South Carolina’s 7th Congressional District. Growing up in a cinder block home with no heating or air conditioning, Russell learned at an early age that hard work and perseverance pave the only true path to the American Dream. He watched his parents work day in and day out to make ends meet. And the values they instilled in him during his upbringing led Russell to self-fund both his undergraduate education at the University of South Carolina, and later his law studies at the Charleston School of Law. At Charleston, Russell served as the President of the Student Bar Association and even helped the school achieve its American Bar Association accreditation. He went on to practice law in the Grand Strand area for over a decade before entering the political arena to serve in the South Carolina House of Representatives for State House District 106 (Horry County). During his seven-year tenure in the SC House, Russell fought to safeguard Constitutional liberties, lower taxes, and put the best interests of South Carolina families above all else. He climbed the ranks to become Chief Majority Whip, and also chaired the House Opioid Prevention Study Committee. Under Russell’s leadership, 18 policy initiatives to combat the opioid crisis were signed into law. Since the first day he stepped foot in Washington, Russell has strived to shake up the corrupt status quo and deliver real change for the American people. He believes adamantly that so long as the American people stand united, we can keep the American Dream alive for every citizen of our great nation. Russell is a dedicated husband to his wife, Bronwen, and a loving father to his son, James. The family lives in Murrells Inlet with their chocolate lab, Jasper.
